Our mission

We're on a mission to create 10 million human firewalls! At revel8, we redefine cybersecurity training with hyper-realistic simulations that reflect today's evolving attack landscape. Our innovative platform combines AI-driven multi-channel attacks with gamified, real-time learning to build resilience where it matters most: the people.


Your mission

We're scaling our core business across the DACH region, and you're right at the heart of it. As a Growth Account Executive, you own the full sales cycle for SMB and key accounts in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland: from first conversation to signed deal. You are the person who turns qualified opportunities into real revenue and builds the relationships that carry revel8 in the DACH market.

How your day-to-day will look like:

  • Own the Full Cycle: You run the sales process end to end — qualifying opportunities, running discovery, giving demos, handling objections, and closing. You take real ownership of your pipeline and your number.
  • Close New Business: You turn qualified opportunities into signed customers, negotiating with decision-makers and navigating DACH-specific buying dynamics to bring deals over the line.
  • Build the Playbook: You are early enough to shape how we sell. You test messaging, refine our approach to local buyers, and feed what works back into a repeatable playbook.
  • Represent revel8: You are the face of our company in DACH, from customer calls to webinars and events. You understand the specific needs of local clients and channel those insights directly into our product and global growth.
  • Work Cross-Functionally: You partner closely with our SDR, marketing, and product teams to keep your pipeline healthy and to make sure the voice of the market is heard across the company.


Is it you we are looking for?

You...

  • have a completed degree, whether in Business, Economics, Engineering, or another field that sharpened your analytical thinking and drive. We welcome diverse backgrounds; what matters most is what you bring to the role, not the exact subject on your diploma.
  • have first experience as an SDR or in sales with a strong track record, ideally in B2B SaaS or another fast-paced environment. You've already built pipeline, qualified opportunities, and talked to potential customers.
  • want to take the next step into full-cycle sales: You're eager to own your own deals, negotiate, and close . And to grow with real ownership.
  • are a motivated, goal-oriented self-starter: You take initiative, work independently, and thrive with real ownership. Ambitious targets energize you rather than scare you.
  • are curious & adaptable: You love opening up something new, challenging the status quo, and finding what works.
  • are excited about cybersecurity & AI: You're curious about how AI is transforming the security space and eager to rethink how security awareness is done.

Why revel8?

  • Our revelutionary Energy: A team that's ambitious, kind, and genuinely excited about what we're building. We move fast, we have fun, and we treat each other well.
  • Timing: Product-market fit is proven. The work now is to scale through rigorous execution.
  • Build, Don't Maintain: You take real ownership early, shape how we sell in DACH, and see your decisions reflected directly in our pipeline and ARR, not a small lever inside a corporate machine.
  • Shared success: Every team member is part of our ESOP program, so everyone shares in what we build.

  • EGYM Wellpass membership for your daily balance.


Ready to join the revelution?

Perfect, let's talk!

Just submit your application, and we'll get back to you as soon as possible. In case you have any questions, feel free to reach out to Melina or Helena from our People & Culture Team. We're looking forward to receiving your application!

Anlagentechniker / Handwerksmeister Heizungs- und Klimatechnik (m/w/d)

Verantwortungsvolle Position mit Perspektive zum Technischen Leiter

Für einen etablierten Eigentümer und Betreiber eines vielseitigen Immobilienportfolios suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine technisch versierte Persönlichkeit im Bereich Heizung, Lüftung und Klimatechnik.

Der Einsatzort befindet sich in der Region südlich der Elbe im erweiterten Hamburger Umland und ist insbesondere für Bewerber aus dem Raum Stade, Buxtehude, Horneburg, Jork, Harsefeld und dem südwestlichen Hamburger Raum gut erreichbar.

  • Eigenverantwortliche Betreuung der technischen Gebäudeausstattung verschiedener Bestandsimmobilien

  • Planung, Ausschreibung, Vergabe und Überwachung technischer Maßnahmen

Die Position ist langfristig als Entwicklungsschritt in Richtung Technische Leitung angelegt.

Sie erhalten die Möglichkeit, sich sukzessive in übergeordnete technische und organisatorische Aufgaben einzuarbeiten und perspektivisch Verantwortung für die technische Infrastruktur und deren Weiterentwicklung zu übernehmen.

data.title: Marketing Manager (m/w/d) Startup Environment
data.description:
Baue als Marketing Manager die Marke hinter einer Technologie auf, die unsere Straßen in Kraftwerke verwandelt und bringe sie in neue Märkte. 💡

Unser Kunde ist ein schnell wachsendes GreenTech Startup aus Mils, das eines der weltweit ersten skalierbaren Straßenkraftwerke entwickelt. Durch die Integration innovativer Energierückgewinnungstechnologie in bestehende Straßen entsteht eine völlig neue Form der erneuerbaren Energiegewinnung, ganz ohne zusätzliche Flächenversiegelung.

Als Marketing & Communications Manager gestaltest du den Marketingbereich von Grund auf mit und sorgst dafür, dass aus einer außergewöhnlichen Technologie eine international sichtbare Marke wird. Dabei geht es nicht nur um Strategie und Kommunikation: Du entwickelst konkrete Go to Market Maßnahmen, setzt eigene Ideen direkt um und arbeitest eng mit Sales, Business Development und der Geschäftsführung daran, unterschiedliche Märkte erfolgreich anzusprechen.

Gesucht wird jemand, der gerne anders denkt, neue Wege ausprobiert und keine Scheu davor hat, auch ungewöhnliche Marketingideen in die Realität umzusetzen. Wenn du Strategie und Hands on Umsetzung verbinden möchtest und Lust darauf hast, Marketing in einem GreenTech Startup langfristig mit aufzubauen, findest du hier jede Menge Gestaltungsspielraum.

Aufgaben

Als Marketing Manager entwickelst du Marketingmaßnahmen für eine außergewöhnliche GreenTech Innovation und sorgst gemeinsam mit Sales und Business Development dafür, dass die Technologie in unterschiedlichen Märkten die richtigen Zielgruppen erreicht.

  • Marketingstrategie: Entwickle den Marketingbereich strategisch weiter und übersetze Unternehmensziele in konkrete Maßnahmen und Kampagnen.
  • Go to Market: Entwickle gezielte Marketingmaßnahmen für bestehende und neue Märkte und unterstütze damit aktiv die internationale Marktbearbeitung.
  • Sales Support: Arbeite eng mit Sales und Business Development zusammen und entwickle Inhalte, Kampagnen und Maßnahmen, die den Vertrieb in unterschiedlichen Märkten wirkungsvoll unterstützen.
  • Kreative Umsetzung: Entwickle neue Marketingideen, teste auch ungewöhnliche Ansätze und bringe erfolgreiche Konzepte schnell und eigenständig in die Umsetzung.
  • Storytelling: Übersetze komplexe technische Themen in verständliche, überzeugende und visuell starke Inhalte für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen.
  • Markenentwicklung: Entwickle Markenidentität, Positionierung und visuellen Auftritt kontinuierlich weiter und schaffe einen konsistenten internationalen Markenauftritt.
  • Kommunikation & PR: Entwickle relevante externe Kommunikation und koordiniere unter anderem Pressemitteilungen, Statements, Eventkommunikation und Medienunterlagen.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im B2B Marketing, Brand Building, Kommunikation, PR oder Kampagnenmanagement.Erfahrung darin, Marketingstrategien nicht nur zu entwickeln, sondern konkrete Maßnahmen selbstständig umzusetzen.
  • Verständnis für Go to Market Strategien und dafür, wie Marketing Sales und Business Development bei der Erschließung unterschiedlicher Märkte unterstützen kann.
  • Die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Themen verständlich, überzeugend und zielgruppengerecht aufzubereiten.
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1 Niveau für eine reibungslose Kommunikation.
  • Kreative Persönlichkeit mit Mut zu unkonventionellen Ideen, Eigeninitiative und Freude daran, neue Ansätze auszuprobieren.
  • Ausgeprägte Hands on Mentalität und Begeisterung dafür, in einem dynamischen Startup Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Strukturen mit aufzubauen.
  • Idealerweise kannst du bereits Beispiele für ungewöhnliche oder besonders kreative Marketingmaßnahmen vorweisen, die du erfolgreich entwickelt und umgesetzt hast.
  • Erfahrung aus einer Marketing- oder Kommunikationsagentur, Kenntnisse in Adobe InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator oder Figma sowie Interesse an GreenTech und nachhaltigen Technologien sind von Vorteil.

Benefits

  • Impact: Baue die Marken- und Kommunikationsstrategie eines der innovativsten GreenTech Startups Europas aktiv mit auf.
  • Verantwortung: Übernimm von Beginn an die strategische Verantwortung für Marketing, Kommunikation und Markenauftritt.
  • Karriere: Wachse gemeinsam mit einem schnell wachsenden ClimateTech Startup und entwickle deinen Verantwortungsbereich mit dem Unternehmen weiter.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Arbeite eng mit Geschäftsführung, Business Development und Sales zusammen und gestalte die Unternehmensstrategie aktiv mit.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Profitiere von Mentoring durch erfahrene Unternehmer sowie kontinuierlichen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Bonus & Beteiligung: Leistungsabhängige Bonuszahlungen sowie die Möglichkeit, dir Unternehmensanteile durch außergewöhnliches Engagement zu erarbeiten.
  • Arbeitsumfeld: Modernes Büro, neueste Technik, kostenlose Getränke und Snacks, Küche sowie großzügige Sozialbereiche.
  • Mobilität: Bike Leasing, organisierte Fahrgemeinschaft zwischen Innsbruck und Mils sowie Firmenparkplatz.
  • Gehalt: Jahresbruttogehalt ab 50.000 € mit deutlicher Bereitschaft zur Überzahlung abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung.

Bereit, Marketing für eine Technologie zu machen, die alles andere als gewöhnlich ist? 💡

Sende uns deinen Lebenslauf und erfahre in einem kurzen 10 minütigen Kennenlerngespräch mehr über das Unternehmen, die Vision und deine zukünftige Rolle.

data.title: Technical Business Analyst (d/f/m)
data.description:
About us

Since 2000, has been making shipping simpler, more transparent, and more efficient for businesses. With our platforms and , companies can quickly compare and directly book their daily shipping needs. By bringing together a wide range of carriers on our platforms, we combine modern technology with personal service.

Across several locations in Europe, our teams work every day to simplify shipping processes in a sustainable way. We believe in open collaboration and fast decision-making. That’s why we are looking for people who take ownership, contribute ideas, and want to actively shape the future with us.

Your mission

As part of our Market Support team for LMS Next/ParcelParcel, you will work alongside a Product Owner and a Business Analyst to keep the platform’s day-to-day operations running smoothly across all live markets (NL, BE, DE, ES, and soon FR) – from technical troubleshooting to customer-facing questions. You’ll work in a fast-paced, pragmatic, hands-on environment, with direct escalation paths to Tech when needed.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • You own the daily inflow of operational and technical support requests for LMS Next/ParcelParcel, acting as the first point of contact and triage before issues are escalated to Product/Tech.
  • You independently diagnose technical issues, such as payment integration failures, frontend display bugs or carrier-specific issues, and determine whether they can be resolved directly or need to be passed on to Tech.
  • You are the point of contact for operational questions about LMS Next/ParcelParcel from internal stakeholders across Customer Service, Sales and Invoicing.
  • You investigate and document the root causes of recurring bugs.

What you need to succeed

  • You have a good technical understanding of web applications, APIs and third-party integrations (e.g. payment providers, carrier APIs, frontend and backend), enabling you to identify where a technical issue originates – coding skills to fix it are not required.
  • You are comfortable working with data to investigate issues independently, e.g. using Metabase, database queries or logs, rather than relying solely on someone else’s assessment.
  • You have experience in Technical Support or as a Technical Business Analyst, ideally in e-commerce, logistics or a SaaS/platform environment.
  • You are fluent in English and have a very good command of German and/or Dutch.
  • You are self-organized and able to independently triage and prioritize an unpredictable daily inflow of requests.
  • You are a strong communicator and can explain technical concepts clearly to internal stakeholders from non-technical teams.
  • You are thorough and detail-oriented, with the patience required for careful bug diagnosis rather than focusing only on quick fixes.
  • You stay calm under pressure and are comfortable working in an operational environment where issues often require an immediate response.

Why ITA Logistics Group?

You can expect a work environment where new ideas are genuinely welcomed and feedback is not just accepted, but actively encouraged. We challenge the status quo, embrace agile ways of working, and continuously evolve. This also means making use of modern digital tools and AI-driven solutions that support your day-to-day work and help make processes more efficient.

  • 30 days of vacation
  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work
  • Time tracking and overtime compensation
  • Subsidized HVV/Deutschlandticket or parking
  • SpenditCard with a monthly credit of €50
  • Company pension scheme
  • Corporate Benefits Program
  • Counseling and support services through the Fürstenberg Institute

Join the ITA Crew

You feel addressed and are interested in joining our team as Technical Business Analyst in beautiful Hamburg?
Please apply stating your earliest possible starting date! Nora Zinnecker is looking forward to your application.

We welcome applications from people of all genders, backgrounds, ages, disabilities, sexual orientations, and religions.

data.title: System Administrator (w/m/d) Defense Products
data.description:
Bei IONOS arbeitest Du bei dem führenden europäischen Anbieter von Cloud-Infrastruktur, Cloud-Services und Hosting-Dienstleistungen partnerschaftlich mit unterschiedlichen Teams zusammen. Wir bieten Dir eine Perspektive in einer der zukunftssichersten Branchen. Uns zeichnen offene Arbeitsstrukturen, Duz-Kultur und flache Hierarchien mit unvergleichlichem Team-Spirit aus. Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass Job und Spaß vereinbar sind und bieten Dir hierfür das entsprechende Umfeld. Bei ständigem Wachstum sind wir stets auf der Suche nach neuen Teammitgliedern. Werde Teil von IONOS und lass uns gemeinsam wachsen.

Join our highly motivated team of experts dedicated to combating cybersecurity threats. As a System Administrator, you will plan and operate our cutting-edge defense platforms alongside site reliability engineers and network engineers. These platforms are crucial for protecting our hosting products and infrastructure, encompassing classic DDoS mitigation, modern Web Application Firewalls (WAF), Zero Trust strategies, and our Content Delivery Network (CDN). We foster a culture that highly values creative ideas, agile working methods, initiative, and participation.

As an Specialist in our Defense squad, you act as a vital shield against daily DDoS and sophisticated cyber attacks. You are the first line of defense, dedicated to neutralizing threats through technical mastery and proactive mitigation.

We are hiring for this role in Karlsruhe and/or Berlin. You will join a distributed, international Defense Platform Services team of approximately 8–9 experts. You will work within specialized squads for Operations, SRE, and NRE to provide comprehensive protection for the group’s infrastructure across Germany and beyond.

Tasks

The day-to-day operations of the Defense Platform Services team directly correlate to the financial stability of the United Internet Group. When our defenders succeed, the group’s digital economy remains fluid; your success is measured by the silence of a neutralized threat.

  • Active Defense & DDoS Mitigation: Administer and troubleshoot scrubbing platforms and a complex, large-scale proxy infrastructure. You will engage in the "cat and mouse game" of fighting attacks in real-time—identifying, washing, and neutralizing malicious traffic to protect core cloud and fiber services.
  • Architectural Density & Operational Excellence: You will manage the lifecycle of 800+ Linux-based components within a highly available infrastructure. To maintain 24/7 group-wide protection, this role requires a mandatory on-call service rotation of one week per month, ensuring immediate response to high-priority network threats.
  • Innovation & Data-Driven Defense: We leverage modern AI tools for log analysis and pattern detection. You will bring creative ideas to the table, utilizing the ELK Stack and ClickHouse to manage high-volume telemetry, identify attack signatures, and devise advanced mitigation strategies.
  • Lifecycle & Pipeline Management: Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines in an agile DevOps environment. You will evaluate and integrate new technologies—including Docker and Kubernetes—to ensure our defense architecture remains lean, efficient, and ahead of evolving industry threats.

Qualifications

Because this role manages critical national and corporate infrastructure, the barrier to entry involves both technical mastery and a high degree of professional trust.Therefore, we require 3 to 5 years of platform operating experience at scale. We are looking for an administrator with a "security gene"—a specialized, proactive interest in DDoS mitigation and cyber defense that goes beyond standard system maintenance.

  • Expert-level proficiency in managing complex, distributed Linux environments.
  • Proven experience configuring Nginx as a reverse proxy or Web Application Firewall (WAF).
  • Practical knowledge of BGP, Flowspec, and Anycast routing.
  • A passion for eliminating repetitive tasks through Ansible, Puppet, and Python.
  • Several years of experience in the administration of complex, distributed Linux systems.
  • Proven experience in configuring and operating Nginx as a reverse proxy or web application firewall.
  • Hands-on experience with the deployment of BGP, Flowspec, and Anycast routing on Linux systems and network routers.
  • Strong passion for automation using tools like Ansible, Puppet, and Python to eliminate repetitive manual tasks.
  • Strong analytical skills to evaluate DDoS attacks, implement effective countermeasures, and continuously develop our defense platforms.
  • Initial experience with technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, ClickHouse, or the ELK Stack is beneficial.
  • Like us, you are a strong advocate for Open Source, especially Linux.

Benefits

  • Hybrid working model.
  • Flexible working hours through trust-based working hours.
  • Subsidized canteen and various free drinks at select locations.
  • Modern office space with excellent public transport connections.
  • Various employee discounts for activities and products.
  • Employee events such as summer and winter parties, as well as workshops.
  • Numerous training and development opportunities.
  • Various health offerings, such as sports and wellness courses.

Über IONOS

IONOS ist der führende europäische Digitalisierungs-Partner für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen (KMU). IONOS hat mehr als sechs Millionen Kundinnen und Kunden und ist mit einer weltweit verfügbaren Plattform in 18 Märkten in Europa und Nordamerika aktiv. Mit seinen Web Presence & Productivity-Angeboten agiert das Unternehmen als “One-Stop-Shop" für alle Digitalisierungs-Bedürfnisse - von Domains und Webhosting über klassische Website-Builder und Do-It-Yourself-Lösungen, von E-Commerce bis zu Online-Marketing-Tools. Darüber hinaus bietet IONOS Cloud-Lösungen für Firmen, die im Zuge der Weiterentwicklung ihres Geschäfts in die Cloud wechseln möchten.

Wir wertschätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von z. B. Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität, körperlichen Merkmalen, Familienstand oder einem anderen sachfremden Kriterium nach geltendem Recht.

data.description:

CES Consulting Engineers Salzgitter GmbH is an independent consulting engineering company with worldwide experience based in Braunschweig, Germany. CES offers solutions to complex multidisciplinary engineering tasks for all civil engineering and related sectors. CES renders services ranging from preliminary investigations to construction supervision and cost controlling, training of the clients' staff, advisory services in the operation and maintenance of installations, as well as the organization and strengthening of public authorities and institutions. CES is looking for an experienced Team Leader / Expert on Communication Strategy with International Experience (f/m/d) for an upcoming GIZ-funded project in the Eastern Caribbean.

The assignment will provide Monitoring, Evaluation, Learning and Communications support to a portfolio of six GIZ projects in the Caribbean. Bei everii arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen Technologie, Kunden und deren individuellen Anforderungen. Du hilfst dabei, Fragen schnell zu klären, Herausforderungen nachhaltig zu lösen und unsere Kundinnen und Kunden für die bestmögliche Nutzung von untermStrich zu begeistern.

Wenn du gerne Verantwortung übernimmst, lösungsorientiert arbeitest und tiefer in die Welt moderner SaaS-Software eintauchen möchtest, freuen wir uns auf dich!

Aufgaben

  • Kundenkommunikation: Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle im Support und im engen Austausch mit unseren Kunden.
  • Anfragenmanagement: Du nimmst Supportanfragen entgegen und sorgst für ihre schnelle Analyse und Lösung.
  • Kundenunterstützung: Du stehst Kunden beratend zur Seite und löst technische sowie funktionale Anfragen rund um unsere Planning-Tools.
  • Lösungsentwicklung: Selbstständige Bearbeitung von Anfragen und Anwendung moderner Tools wie Datenbanken und Ticketsysteme.
  • Produktverbesserung: Du erkennst Optimierungsmöglichkeiten und gibst wertvolles Feedback zur Produktverbesserung weiter.
  • Dokumentation: Du pflegst und entwickelst unsere Support-Dokumentationen und gibst hilfreiche Beiträge für unsere Wissensdatenbank.

Qualifikation

  • Grundvoraussetzung: Du verfügst über Grundkenntnisse im Umgang mit AI-Tools, begeisterst dich für AI und bist bereit, diese Tools aktiv im Arbeitsalltag einzusetzen.
  • Qualifikation: Du konntest bereits erste Berufserfahrung im (technischen) Support sammeln.

About Unity Advisory
Unity Advisory is a modern advisory business built for today's CFO. It combines deep expertise with an AI-native operating model designed to deliver better evidence, faster execution and stronger client outcomes.

Through direct access to the expertise needed to solve complex challenges and a pace of delivery that enables organisations to seize opportunities, Unity delivers advisory as it should be, through a model that is free from audit conflict.

The Role


The Sec Ops Analyst owns hands-on security monitoring and assurance across our Microsoft, AWS and Databricks environments. Working closely with our managed SOC, you'll investigate alerts and incidents, close monitoring gaps, and keep our ISO/IEC 27001:2022 controls backed by complete, audit-ready evidence — including running customer and client security-assurance questionnaires on the business's behalf.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor, correlate and triage security alerts and activity across Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, AWS, Databricks, endpoints and network services, using native tools and the central SIEM.

  • Act as the primary internal contact for the managed SOC, owning incidents, escalations and follow-up through to resolution within agreed service levels.

  • Close monitoring gaps by improving detection use cases, alert logic, playbooks and escalation criteria.

  • Own the evidence cycle for ISO/IEC 27001:2022 controls — mapping, collecting and maintaining audit-ready evidence, and resolving gaps with control owners.

  • Support internal, certification and surveillance audits, tracking findings and corrective actions to closure.

  • Monitor privileged access and authentication activity, review vulnerability findings, and use Microsoft Purview to manage data protection and DLP risk.

  • Complete customer and third-party security assurance questionnaires with accurate, evidence-backed responses.

  • Run phishing simulations and security-awareness activity, and report on incidents, vulnerabilities and control evidence to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Hands-on SecOps experience using SIEM, EDR/XDR and cloud/identity telemetry, ideally with a managed SOC.

  • Practical Microsoft security experience (Sentinel, Defender, Entra ID, Purview) and exposure to AWS; Databricks familiarity a plus.

  • Demonstrable ISO/IEC 27001:2022 experience — collecting and presenting control evidence, resolving gaps, supporting audits.

  • Experience completing client security assurance questionnaires.

  • Strong analytical and stakeholder-management skills, comfortable managing multiple incidents and audit requests at once.

  • Desirable: Cyber Essentials Plus exposure, GRC/evidence-management platforms, and certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, SC-200 or Security+.

Work Environment


A truly hybrid and flexible working environment, at the forefront of AI-driven advisory. You'll have real input into how security operations are run and evidenced from day one.

About Motorway

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. We're looking for talented folks to join our Customer Experience team – the heart and soul of Motorway. This role is based on-site at our vibrant Brighton office.

As a Customer Experience Specialist, you'll be the friendly voice and expert guide for our customers, making sure they have a smooth and enjoyable journey with us. Within the Customer Experience Specialist role, there are two distinct functions:

  1. Seller Support Specialist: Manage post-sale inquiries and resolutions, including handling transportation issues and processing cancellations, with a focus on customer satisfaction and sales retention.

  2. Sales Completion Specialist: As a trusted expert for car sellers, you will lead post-auction negotiations and collaborate with internal teams to ensure fair deals and seamless alignment between sellers and dealers.

We will evaluate your experience and preferences during the screening call and place you where we think you would be best suited to succeed.

We're not your typical call centre. No rigid scripts or endless queues here. We're using tech to shake up the car industry. We're empowering buyers and sellers to get the best deals.   • Impactful Work: You're not just answering calls; you're guiding customers through our cutting-edge online platform, using your skills to solve real problems and make their car selling experience amazing.

What you'll be doing

  • Building genuine connections: Chatting with car sellers and dealers, answering their questions, and building trust.

  • Finding creative solutions: Using your initiative and problem-solving skills to tackle any challenges.

About you

  • You genuinely enjoy helping people and have a knack for building rapport.

  • You're a quick learner and enjoy solving problems.

As a Lead Product Designer at Motorway, you won't just be producing great design - you'll be raising the ceiling for everyone around you. You'll shape how the team works, set the standard for craft and rigour, and bring a clear point of view on where design is heading.

You'll take ownership of our most complex design challenges, working across the full product lifecycle from discovery to delivery. data.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Lead
data.description:
Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company, with frontier AI embedded at every step in the production of critical physical products - from creating advanced materials to engineering and manufacturing.

Every Orbital Industries product is developed using CurieOS, our AI operating system, uniting AI-automated hardware engineering with AI-designed material science to achieve breakthrough real-world performance. We also offer CurieOS to our customers and partners, extending the same platform and workflows that power Orbital Industries to their own teams and products.

We have an ambitious mission and need excellent people in all our teams - AI research, operations, advanced materials, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering and manufacturing.

Working at Orbital Industries means working in vertically integrated teams across the full stack, from molecules to manufacturing. We're looking for people who have a love of physical technology, curiosity in AI and a desire to learn.

Role Overview

Orbital's AI software platform, CurieOS, is used by scientists and engineers to design and build products serving critical industries. Powering this software are our world leading AI models in advanced materials, hardware engineering and simulation.

As Forward Deployed Engineering Lead at Orbital you will build and lead the Forward Deployed Engineering function, owning its technical standards, delivery model and team. You are an engineering leader who builds alongside customers, not a delivery leader who manages engineers. You will deliver complex deployments hands-on while hiring and developing the team that scales this capability across Orbital's growing customer base.

First and foremost, we want to work with someone with a love of craftsmanship, continual learning and building systems that scale.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver deployments hands-on, across the breadth of industrial R&D

  • Drive customer adoption so CurieOS becomes how their scientists and engineers work day-to-day

  • Deliver complex customer deployments hands-on, writing production code, designing architectures, building integrations and debugging issues across CurieOS and customer systems

  • Own the technical quality of deployments from prototype through production, including reliability, maintainability and operational performance

  • Design and build systems that connect heterogeneous software, data and physical infrastructure, from simulation campaigns and digital twins to lab instruments, test rigs and CAD/PLM systems

  • Develop reusable integration patterns that allow CurieOS to operate reliably across complex customer environments

Own delivery end-to-end

  • Embed with customer teams to understand ambiguous, high-value R&D problems, challenge assumptions and identify where CurieOS can deliver meaningful impact

  • Translate those problems into a technical approach, milestones and acceptance criteria, making pragmatic architecture and scope trade-offs as you learn

  • Own the engagement from initial technical discovery through implementation, production deployment and adoption

  • Set KPIs per engagement (screening throughput, design-cycle reduction, experiments avoided), measure pre/post and report outcomes to executive sponsors

Build and lead the team

  • Build and lead the Forward Deployed Engineering function, owning its technical standards, engineering practices and delivery model

  • Hire, develop and manage exceptional Forward Deployed Engineers across diverse scientific and engineering domains

  • Set the technical bar through code and architecture review, and act as the escalation point for the most difficult technical decisions and production issues

  • Staff engagements based on technical complexity and individual strengths, while developing engineers into increasingly independent technical leaders

  • Codify successful approaches into reusable architectures, tooling and playbooks so the team becomes more effective as it scales

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in enterprise software technical delivery or forward deployed engineering roles, you have led complex deployments and written production code alongside customers

  • Experience building a forward deployed engineering or solutions function, hiring the team, setting the standards and defining the delivery model

  • The ability to move fluidly between strategy conversations with R&D leadership and debugging sessions with engineers

  • A track record of succeeding in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where requirements evolve through direct iteration with users

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, you still build, and your technical judgement is respected by the engineers you lead

  • A genuine interest in building software that enables breakthrough scientific and industrial applications

Orbital is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to take the next step in their nursing career within a supportive, specialist-led equine hospital.

Donnington Grove Vets is a large equine hospital and ambulatory practice based in Newbury, providing first opinion, referral and emergency services. Our impressive facilities include a full surgical suite, advanced diagnostic imaging including MRI, CT, bone scan and an on-site laboratory. 

With a strong reputation for clinical excellence and specialist-led care, we manage a varied caseload ranging from sports and leisure horses through to racehorses and foals.

Our nursing team is a huge part of what makes the practice special. You’ll work alongside colleagues at a range of experience levels, from pre-trainees through to fully qualified RVNs, as well as dedicated yard and theatre support teams. This structure provides an excellent environment for collaboration, mentoring and continued professional development.

 

How You’ll Make a Difference

 
As Senior Theatre Nurse, you’ll play a key role in the smooth and safe running of our equine theatre and surgical services, working closely with veterinary surgeons and the wider nursing team to deliver a high standard of patient care throughout the peri-operative period.
 
Alongside your clinical responsibilities, you’ll help lead standards within theatre, support and mentor junior colleagues and contribute to the ongoing development of our nursing protocols and ways of working.
 

Working Pattern

 
* 40 hours per week across 5 days
* Shifts between 7:00am and 8:30pm, with early and late starts to cover morning and afternoon theatre
* 1 in 7 weekends, 8:00am – 8:30pm
 

General Responsibilities

 
* Providing high-quality nursing care to equine surgical patients
* Preparing patients, theatre and equipment for emergency and elective general anaesthesia and standing procedures
* Supporting veterinary surgeons during anaesthesia and surgery
* Assisting with patient recovery and post-operative care
* Supporting and mentoring junior members of the nursing team, including acting as a Clinical Coach
* Maintaining high standards of theatre cleanliness, organisation and infection control
* Ensuring theatre equipment and consumables are maintained, prepared and ready for use
* Supporting stock control, ordering, equipment servicing and the operational running of theatre
* Contributing to the continued development of theatre protocols and nursing standards
* Working collaboratively with the wider clinical team to deliver excellent patient care
 

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

 
We’re looking for an experienced and confident Registered Veterinary Nurse who enjoys working as part of a team and is ready to take greater responsibility within a busy theatre environment. You’ll bring:
 
* Registration as a Veterinary Nurse with the RCVS
* Strong theatre nursing experience gained within an equine or small animal environment
* Horse handling experience
* Confidence supporting anaesthesia, surgical procedures and peri-operative patient care
* Strong communication skills and the ability to build positive working relationships with colleagues
* Good organisational skills and the ability to manage priorities effectively within a busy clinical environment
* An interest in supporting, mentoring and developing other members of the nursing team
* A proactive approach to learning, reflection and continuous improvement
 

How We’ll Support You

 
At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:
 
* A varied and rewarding senior nursing role within a specialist-led equine hospital
* Opportunities to develop your theatre, surgical and leadership experience
* Clear career pathways with progression opportunities into senior nursing, referral and leadership roles, as well as Clinical Coach, mentoring and certificate pathways
* Ongoing learning and development supported by experienced colleagues and specialist clinical teams
* A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, community and continuous improvement
 

What We Offer Our Team

 
* 6.6 weeks' annual leave plus your birthday off
* Increasing holiday allowance based on length of service
* Enhanced family-friendly policies, including maternity, paternity, adoption, shared parental and surrogacy pay
* Private Medical Insurance
* Employee wellbeing initiatives including Healthcare Cash Plan and Cycle to Work scheme
* £550 CPD allowance plus 24 hours' paid CPD leave
* Certificate support
* RCVS and VDS fees covered
* Pension scheme
* Discounted veterinary care
* Voluntary benefits including Green Cars salary sacrifice scheme and access to discounts and cashback with hundreds of participating retailers
 

We’re committed to supporting our people through career development opportunities, wellbeing initiatives and access to world-class learning resources.

 

Whether you’re looking to build on your theatre experience, develop your leadership skills or take the next step in your nursing career, inspiring vet care offers the support, opportunity and community to help you grow.

At Bike Club, we offer subscriptions for children's bikes that grow with your kids. Families pay a monthly fee, and when their children outgrow their bikes, we exchange them for a larger size. We refurbish the used bikes and make them available to other families. It's sustainable and hassle-free.

About the Role

HTS Assist is Hopper's agentic AI assistant for travel, resolving flight changes, cancellations, refunds, and bookings over chat and voice for some of the world's largest travel brands. We're looking for a senior full stack engineer to anchor this product, owning the realtime and voice layer end to end while building across React/TypeScript front ends, Scala and Python services, and cloud infrastructure. The team is lean and senior, ownership is broad, and the path from your code to a traveler's phone call is short.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Own the voice channel end to end, including telephony and CPaaS integrations (e.g., Twilio, Amazon Connect), streaming speech-to-text and text-to-speech pipelines, realtime model orchestration, and latency and quality budgets

  • Build product features across the stack, including web chat front ends in React/TypeScript, backend services in Scala and Python, and infrastructure on GCP

  • Design for multi-tenant scale, with one codebase serving many partners through configuration rather than forks

  • Build the safety and compliance plumbing enterprise partners audit, including guardrails, content filtering, and PII redaction integration points

  • Keep revenue-critical deployments healthy through observability, alerting, incident response, and SLA performance

  • Build the platform capabilities forward-deployed engineers configure for partner telephony integrations and go-lives

  • Raise the engineering bar through code review, architecture reviews, and mentoring

An ideal candidate has

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, with senior-level ownership of production systems and genuine full-stack range

  • Hands-on realtime systems experience, such as voice applications, WebRTC/SIP, streaming media, or comparable low-latency products

  • Strength in a modern front end (React, TypeScript) and depth on the backend (Scala or another JVM language, and/or Python), along with cloud infrastructure experience on GCP or AWS

  • A track record designing, building, and maintaining RESTful APIs, microservices, or event-driven systems

  • Familiarity using AI coding tools as a standard part of their workflow, with the judgment to review, correct, and own everything that ships

  • An operable-systems mindset, covering SLAs, observability, on-call rotations, and rollback plans

  • The ability to break down complex problems, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and ship iteratively, backed by strong communication across product, design, and operations

  • Bonus points for conversational AI or LLM orchestration experience, including speech technologies such as Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Whisper, or OpenAI Realtime

  • Bonus points for working knowledge of cloud telephony or CPaaS platforms such as Twilio, Amazon Connect, Genesys, or LiveKit

  • Bonus points for experience building customer service, CRM, contact center, or workflow automation tools

  • Familiarity with travel industry technologies (PSS/GDS, hotel PMS/CRS) is a plus, though not required

Perks and benefits of working with us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary, upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

  • Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for the employee for a group insurance plan through Vitality Health

  • Automatic contributions when you start with Hopper through Smart Pension

  • Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards

  • Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk and a work-from-home stipend

  • Carrot Cash travel stipend

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

  • Open communication with management and company leadership

  • Small, dynamic teams, massive impact

About Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally, powering Hopper's mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions, helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers, with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we've grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world's largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners' direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company's recent growth:

  • Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS' channels every year.

  • Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance, have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.

  • Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking, and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking versus if they booked just travel.

  • Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper's fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agency in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen Z and millennial travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love.

That takes high standards, high velocity and engineers who own what they ship.

Today, we serve over 6 million clients, with more than €38 billion in assets under management. At that scale, frontend architecture, performance and product quality have material business consequences.

Our frontend platform spans web and mobile: TypeScript, React, React Native and React Native Web in an Nx and pnpm monorepo, with TanStack Query, Zustand, Playwright, Detox and Jest. Around 95% of our code is reused across web and mobile.

About the role

Staff Frontend Engineers shape architecture and engineering direction across product teams while remaining close to the code. Your scope will include shared libraries, platform capabilities, developer tooling and difficult product-system problems.

This is not a people-management role. Its leverage comes from technical judgement, credible execution and making other engineers and teams more effective.

What you’ll do

  • Set direction for frontend architecture across React, React Native and the shared monorepo.

  • Own cross-team problems in platform capabilities, shared libraries, design-system foundations, tooling and developer experience.

  • Lead decisions on boundaries, abstractions, state and data flow, performance, testing and migration strategy.

  • Diagnose systemic rendering, bundle, runtime and release-quality problems and create durable fixes.

  • Remain hands-on where implementation, prototyping or technical investigation is the fastest way to create clarity.

  • Partner with product, backend engineering and QA on risks and decisions that cross team boundaries.

  • Mentor senior engineers, raise review quality and make sound frontend judgement easier to reproduce across teams.

  • Balance standardisation with team autonomy, avoiding platform work that creates more friction than leverage.

What you need to have

  • Evidence of architectural or platform impact across multiple frontend teams.

  • Deep ownership of complex production systems built with React or React Native and TypeScript.

  • Strong judgement in application boundaries, shared libraries, state management, performance and migration design.

  • A track record of improving developer effectiveness, reliability or product quality through durable mechanisms.

  • Practical experience diagnosing performance and correctness problems across web or mobile systems.

  • The ability to influence technical direction through evidence, clarity and trusted execution rather than title.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

Our National Security and AI Safety business unit is dedicated to advancing the responsible development and deployment of AI in support of national security and global stability. data.title: GTM
data.description:
We're Heidi

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. In just 18 months, our clinical AI products have absorbed the administrative chaos of 73 million patient visits. Today, we support over 2.5 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world's healthcare capacity and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

If you don't choose easy and you want to build something way bigger than yourself, we might be a good place for you to start.

Our perspective on GTM

We believe that sales has fundamentally changed in the last 6 months. The repetitive work is automated now: AI does the market research, drafts the emails, summarises and scores the calls.

The last year has taught us that the people who succeed have a blend of the following traits.

  • Intellectual dexterity: consultant-like ability to structure and break down a problem into its constituent parts, think from first principles, and self-improve rapidly. Inherent curiosity goes a long way here.

  • Natural charisma: can build rapport with anyone. You work out quickly who you're talking to, what they're dealing with and what they actually need, then have the conversation that gets you both somewhere.

  • Drive & focus: as AI commoditises intelligence, work ethic and agency matter more. An outlier candidate here is far more productive than the mean than they were two years ago, and the gap keeps widening.

  • The mark of humanity: in a world filling up with AI slop, work where you can feel the person behind it stands out. Where the copy, the imagery, and the strategy is indelibly human.

We don't think the talent market has caught up with how GTM is changing, so we’re open minded - title or experience isn’t important. Most of our team started outside the profession: VC, consulting and creative are common.

This role is high leverage, highly rewarding, and intellectually stimulating. We want you to be part of that.

The role

Heidi sits in an unusual position. We lead a category being built for the first time. Hundreds of thousands of clinicians found us on their own, started using the product for free and told a colleague. The market is genuinely open and the clinicians in it already like the product. Your job is to turn that quiet enthusiasm into real revenue conversations.

You're the first line to Heidi. Inbound demand and product signals point you at practices and hospital groups already using us, and you decide whether to qualify each one in, out, or close it yourself. The signals tell you who to reach out to, you decide how.

This is the first rung of our UK sales org, and for most clinicians you'll be the first person from Heidi they ever speak to. How they feel about us afterwards is largely down to you. You'll triage the inbound to your Account Executive's where it belongs and close your own deals from day one, because we want people as close to the frontline as possible. You'll build a network across UK healthcare that outlasts the role.

What this means practically:

  • Work the inbound queue and the warm product signals. Your day goes to clinicians and practices already using Heidi, where the product tells you who's outgrown the free version

  • Research the accounts behind those signals, work out who else in the practice or hospital group needs to be in the conversation, and build the angle for each one

  • Reach the people the signals point to, across calls, email and social, while the interest is still fresh

  • Book demos and meetings for your AEs with enough context that nothing is lost in the handoff

  • Own small SMB deals end to end, from first conversation through to closed

  • Keep the CRM accurate, keep the pipeline moving and hit your qualified-lead number every month

  • Partner with AEs, Marketing, Product, Operations and Customer Success so what you promise on the call matches what clinicians get

  • Track what's shifting in UK healthcare and across the competitive set, then tell the team what you're hearing on the phones

What you'll need

  • You've worked somewhere with a high bar, whether that's tech, creative, banking, consulting or PE/VC. We care more about what you've achieved than any time in a sales role.

  • You care about what we do. You'd rather learn how the product actually works than memorise a pitch.

  • You can hold a conversation with anyone and get to the point of it fast. Clinicians have twenty patients before lunch. You respect that and still get the meeting.

  • Organised and autonomously functioning. You run your own list, your own day and your own follow-ups without being chased.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

Attitude beats experience here. If you're hungry, competitive and you like solving the problem in front of you, we want to hear from you.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You'll join a team focused on real-world impact over imaginary valuations and glossy PR. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we'd like to see. We're medicos, engineers, builders, and designers who've felt the moral and practical toll of what non-care feels like. True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Building what we're building isn't always easy. But we didn't choose easy, we chose to build something that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognise that the deeper question isn't whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it. The work is hard, but you will trust and admire the people you work beside, and rest easy knowing you're doing the defining work of your career.

We take care of you

We offer comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a £100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a £500 home office budget, a £700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to £7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

data.title: Marketing General Application
data.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

Why this job posting

We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent.

The best hires rarely arrive the moment a perfectly matching job posting happens to be live. So we're not waiting. You might not fit one of our current open roles, and that's fine. If you're genuinely great at what you do, we want you, and we'll find work for you!

Tell us what you're brilliant at and where you'd have the most impact, and we'll figure out the right seat together.

What it's like to work here

A few things that are true about working here:

We move fast. Really fast. Hours and days, not weeks or months.

We keep it light. Few meetings, little bureaucracy, less talking and more doing. And we default to doing it ourselves before adding dependencies, because pulling other people in slows everything down for everyone.

We hold a high bar. Average loses. Even good often does. We're here to do the best work of our careers, and we back each other to get there, low ego, high trust.

It's not an easy game. We're in AI, the most competitive space in the world, and nobody is going to give us this market. We have to take it.

But the impact is real. You'll see your work land. If you want to build things you're proud of, this is the place.

Where you might fit

We hire top talent across the whole function. A few of the areas where you might fit:

  • Performance. Own paid end to end and turn spend into pipeline and revenue.

  • Growth. Own the experiments and loops that compound over time.

  • Field. Own the events and 1:1 and 1:few plays that accelerate deals by region.

  • SEO. Win traditional and AI search. Ship the best content and world-class landing pages.

  • Brand and Creative. Make Synthesia impossible to ignore.

  • Copywriting. Write copy that lands. Make every word earn its place.

  • Organic Social. Build organic presence across platforms. Go viral with content people love.

  • Product and Customer Marketing. Position it. Launch it. Tell the story.

  • Lifecycle. Turn new signups into engaged customers who stick and grow.

  • Analytics and Measurement. Turn data into the team's sharpest decisions.

Not seeing your exact discipline? Apply anyway and tell us where you'd have the most impact.

About you

  • You get results. Pipeline, adoption, revenue. You can point to the numbers.

  • You live in the data. You reach for the numbers and tell signal from noise.

  • You can write. Sharp positioning and copy, with a point of view you'll defend.

  • You own it. Blank slate, your call. You move and adjust based on what works.

  • You run solo. You get things done without pulling in a crowd.

  • You adapt fast. Priorities shift, channels change, AI rewrites the playbook. You keep up.

  • You love AI. You want to build a category-defining product at one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the world.

Apply

Apply here. In a line or two, tell us where you fit and what you'd want to own. We review on a rolling basis, and when there's a match with a current or upcoming role, we'll reach out. What you share stays with us for future openings too.

Want to skip the queue? Message Borys Khodan, VP of Marketing, on LinkedIn and make your case:

  • Where you'd have the most impact. A few sharp bullet points.

  • What you're proudest of. Real wins, with the numbers behind them.

Show us the work. That's what gets our attention.

About the role:

From the moment a team opens Camunda for the first time, our job is to help them succeed — fast. As Principal Product Manager for Time to First Production, you'll own exactly that experience: the journey from a new team's very first workspace (or first local start) to their first process running confidently in production. Your mission is simple to say and genuinely exciting to build: make that first win happen sooner, more smoothly, and more reliably than ever before.

You'll be the DRI for one of Product Strategy's three company-wide outcome areas, with real license to shape it — define what a great first experience looks like, build the measurement that proves we're delivering it, and set the strategy and priorities that Engineering, Design, and our Experience org build against. It's a founding-type mandate: the outcome area is established and the ambition is clear, and you'll have the room to define the metric, the roadmap, and the experience that gets us there.

You'll work at the intersection of Camunda's push into agentic, AI-first ways of building (AI-assisted modeling, agentic development, ProcessOS-style process re-engineering) and the fundamentals of a great first-run experience (onboarding, guided building, testing, and the path to production). It's a role for someone who loves turning a bold, company-wide ambition — delight customers from day one — into a measurable, funded, and genuinely exciting product

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You Will Do:

  • Own the Time to First Production outcome area end to end: define its north-star metric(s), the customer journey they represent, and the roadmap of investments ("rocks" and initiatives) that move them.

  • Bring an outside-in, evidence-based lens — grounding roadmap decisions in real customer needs and feedback, not internal assumptions.

What You Bring:

  • Significant experience as a Principal/Staff-level Product Manager owning a cross-cutting, metrics-driven outcome or platform area (not a single feature surface) in B2B or enterprise SaaS.

  • A track record of building measurement and north-star metrics from scratch — comfortable partnering with data/analytics functions to go from "we don't really know" to a credible, trusted number.

  • Strong influence and cross-functional leadership skills: you can align Engineering, Design, GTM, and executive stakeholders around a strategy without relying on formal authority.

  • Excellent written communication — this role's primary tool is the strategy document that others build against, so clear, structured writing matters as much as decision-making.

  • A genuine passion for customer experience, paired with comfort shaping your own remit as the outcome area, its metric, and its roadmap continue to evolve.

  • An interest in (or track record with) AI-native and agentic ways of working — Camunda's product organization is actively building for a world where AI agents build, test, and even help re-engineer processes.

Nice to Haves:

  • Background in process automation, workflow orchestration, BPM, or developer platforms.

  • Experience partnering with Product Marketing / Analyst Relations on category or outcome-level positioning.

Data Scientist - Partner Flow

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Partner Flow team

You'll own experimentation and analytics for iwoca's partner channel – fintechs and platforms that embed iwoca lending in their own products. The analytical approach is still being built, and the scope to shape it is wide.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Partner Flow owns the customer journey from the moment someone starts an application on a partner platform through to a completed credit assessment. By making the application process as smooth as possible and collecting the data needed for a credit decision efficiently, the team maximises the number of partner-referred customers that receive an offer. The team works across the full application stack – from the APIs partners use to integrate iwoca, through to the experience customers see when they apply.

The team is small and cross-functional, combining data science, engineering, design, and product. Active projects include:

  • Pre-qualification – testing how showing customers an offer before they apply affects conversion and long-term value

  • Credit card strategy – iwoca recently launched a credit card alongside its flexi-loan; the team is working out which product, or combination, to offer which customers

  • Funnel optimisation – identifying and reducing the biggest points of friction across the partner journey

The role

You'll design experiments, model customer behaviour and analyse large data sets across the partner funnel, and turn findings into product and strategy decisions. The analytical approach is still being shaped - you'll influence how it develops, not just what it produces.

The work has direct commercial consequences – on partner platforms, iwoca competes for attention alongside other lenders, and what this team builds and tests affects which customers convert and on what terms. You'll work closely with commercial, strategy, and product colleagues across the business.

  • Experimentation and causal inference. You'll design and analyse experiments where careful randomisation and interpretation are critical. You'll need to know where standard A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead. The problems are consequential: measuring how pre-qualification affects Customer Lifetime Value (CLTV), and understanding how different products interact when offered to the same customer base.

  • Funnel and competitive strategy. You'll analyse the full partner-referred customer journey – from application through to credit assessment – identifying where conversion breaks down and why. On partner platforms, iwoca is positioned alongside competitors, so you'll also figure out what makes customers choose iwoca over the alternatives, and how to shift those dynamics in our favour.

  • Commercial translation. You'll be directly involved when decisions get made – not handing off analysis to be interpreted by someone else. You'll work with commercial and strategy colleagues and coordinate with adjacent teams to make sure the tests and policies you run fit together with their ongoing work.

  • AI and ways of working. You'll use AI to accelerate and automate your analytical work. The team treats this as a lever for increasing its rate of learning. You'll be expected to have a view on where it helps and where it doesn't.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Statistical foundations. Strong grounding in probability and statistics, with an understanding of Bayesian reasoning and experience applying hierarchical modelling or decision-making under uncertainty.

  • Causal inference. Experience separating signal from noise in observational and experimental data.

  • Business translation. Ability to understand commercial context and translate data into actionable insights that guide decisions - not just produce analysis, but land it with people who act on it.

  • Data tooling. Proficiency with data manipulation and modelling tools.

  • Analytical ownership. Comfortable owning ambiguous problems end-to-end - from framing through modelling to influencing decisions.

  • AI fluency. Experience with and a passion for using AI to accelerate and automate analysis and model building.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, adapting technical detail to different audiences.

Bonus:

  • Modelling depth. Experience building or adapting statistical or ML models, with an interest in understanding what's happening underneath.

  • Stochastic methods. Familiarity with stochastic modelling concepts as they apply to inference, time series, or uncertainty.

  • Funnel and marketplace experience. Experience with conversion funnel analysis or marketplace dynamics where you're competing for attention alongside competitors.

  • Python. You work primarily in Python. If your background is R or another language, that's fine - but Python is what the team uses day to day.

  • Market curiosity. You want to understand how the partner lending market actually works - what makes a partner choose iwoca over a competitor, and what makes a customer convert.

The salary

We expect to pay from £70,000 – £80,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

data.description:
About The Role and Team

Quantum Motion is a fast-growing quantum computing scale-up based in London founded by internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University with over 40 years’ experience in developing qubits and quantum computing architectures. Bringing together state-of-the-art cryogenic facilities and an outstanding interdisciplinary team, we are developing quantum processors based on industrial-grade silicon chips, with the potential to radically transform computing power in areas such as materials modelling, medicine, artificial intelligence and more.


Our Team

Since 2021 our team has been listed every year in the “Top 100 Startups worth watching” in the EE Times, and our technology breakthroughs have been featured in The Telegraph, BBC and the New Statesman. Our founders are internationally renowned researchers from UCL and Oxford University who have pioneered the development of qubits and quantum computing architectures. Our chairman is the co-founder of Cadence and Synopsys, the two leading companies in the area of Electronic Design Automation. We’re backed by a team of top-tier investors, and we have recently closed our Series C funding of $160 million.

We bring together the brightest quantum engineers, integrated circuit (IC) engineers, quantum computing theoreticians and software engineers to create a unique, world-leading team, working together closely to maximise our combined expertise. Our collaborative and interdisciplinary culture is an ideal fit for anyone who thrives in a cutting-edge research and development environment focused on tackling big challenges and contributing to the development of scalable quantum computers based on silicon technology.
 
Our team of 100+ is based in Oxford and London, with a centre of mass in our Islington lab.


Functions of the Role

As Director of Systems Delivery, you will build and lead the function responsible for the complete lifecycle of Quantum Motion’s full-stack silicon quantum systems, from initial programme planning, build, and integration through commissioning, acceptance testing, and handover. 

You will drive cross-functional alignment across hardware, software, systems integration, and operations. Key priorities include establishing delivery playbooks, acceptance protocols, and customer site infrastructure readiness, while synchronising complex silicon bring-up with agile software developments.

We are seeking a pragmatic leader with proven experience managing multidisciplinary teams to deploy first-of-a-kind, deep-tech systems into field environments. Direct hardware experience in silicon, semiconductor, or advanced physical instrumentation is mandatory; you must understand physical build constraints, microelectronics/systems integration, and environmental facility requirements.

  • Full-Stack System Execution: Lead the Systems Delivery capability to execute internal full-stack system deployments, bridging physical hardware with full-stack software from assembly through customer handover.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Coordinate across hardware, software, product, and operations teams to align physical hardware build schedules with software release cycles, managing dependency interfaces and trade-offs.

  • Site Infrastructure Readiness: Oversee internal and customer site infrastructure preparation to ensure physical environments are ready for deployment.

  • Acceptance Testing & Governance: Implement delivery schedules, risk management, and formal acceptance testing protocols.

  • Service & Operational Handoff: Establish post-installation support frameworks, handovers, and field engineering processes to guarantee long-term operational uptime.

  • Process Standardisation: Build scalable playbooks, quality standards, and repeatable processes for integration, validation, and operational readiness. 

  • Supply Chain Management: Manage technical hardware procurement, key vendor relationships, and supplier performance supporting delivery timelines.                                                                  

  • Commercial Scoping Support: Provide technical scoping, feasibility input, and operational planning for commercial proposals while fostering team accountability.


Experience - Essentials

  • Must have proven experience managing physical hardware systems (e.g., quantum, semiconductor, aerospace, or advanced scientific instrumentation) with a realistic understanding of physical build constraints and lead times.

  • Demonstrated background managing hardware-software integration, physical systems validation, and site-installation constraints.

  • Experience building, managing, and mentoring hardware, systems integration, or field delivery teams.

  • Track record of taking first-of-a-kind physical hardware platforms from prototype to repeatable deployment models.

  • Hands-on experience managing facility readiness and running structured customer acceptance protocols.

  • Strong project management expertise tracking HW/SW critical paths, project budgets, risk registers, and executive reporting.

  • Direct experience overseeing technical vendors, supplier selection, and component procurement.
