Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com. 

Bitwarden truly cares and wants all Bitwarden users to have the best experience while accessing their sensitive information. The Customer Success team helps customers and all users meaningfully engage with Bitwarden products while proactively planning for user growth, service availability, and to ultimately achieve their desired outcome. Team members have excellent product knowledge, superb technical skills, stellar grammar, attention to detail, and the ability to explain complicated things simply.

Bitwarden seeks a server and cloud enthusiast, with experience in both communicating about and deploying these technologies. You will become a Bitwarden product expert and partner with the Customer Engagement Managers to help customers with their initial production deployments post-sales, as well as implement new features as they are released and increase their adoption of the Bitwarden platform.

This is an all-remote team and we're looking for someone located in the UK.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Functioning as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Bitwarden and its suite of services
  • Leading technical planning and execution of new deployments, both to establish and adopt best-practices with a focus on large Enterprise engagements
  • Advising customers on industry best practices for the full stack of Bitwarden  
  • Working with customers to solve issues and/or look ahead to identify solutions to situations they may face in the future
  • Providing superb guidance and assistance for each customer's implementation of Bitwarden and general security
  • Serve as a dedicated customer point of contact for named customers through alignment to Customer Engagement Manager resources through the Bitwarden ticketing and email systems
  • Participate in customer quarterly business reviews by assisting in environment audits, best-practices reviews, and positioning new product features relevant to further expansion opportunities and/or increased adoption
  • Collaborating with Engineering and Product associates to triage bug reports and feature requests based on customer need and scale with a focus on large Enterprise deployments
  • Assist training and culture sharing in the Implementation Engineering Team
  • Guide knowledge sharing among Implementation Engineers within the team and in collaboration with Technical Writing to share best-practices, troubleshooting information, and recommended configurations
  • Lead and/or assist in internal team projects including customer environment replication for bug investigations, integrations with new third-party tools, and development of automations both for customer use-cases as well as internal team processes
  • Occasionally represent Bitwarden at customer meetings, industry events, or team offsites (some travel may be required).

WHAT YOU BRING TO BITWARDEN

  • Excellent English and grammar
  • Excellent problem-solving skills (you might not know all the answers but you know how to find and communicate the solutions)
  • A passion for supporting your team members, growing together (technical ability and emotional intelligence), and sharing your knowledge with all
  • A strong sense of empathy and the ability to advocate for others
  • A passion for helping Bitwarden users
  • Experience from a previous technical position (e.g. Systems Engineer, Implementation Engineer, DevOps Engineer, IT Infrastructure Engineer, etc). Equivalent education or demonstrable skills may be accepted
  • Ability and desire to work remotely

Familiarity with several of the following areas/technologies is preferred:

  • Bitwarden

  • SMTP
  • SAML and OpenID Connect
  • TLS/SSL and PKI

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Screening call with our Recruiting Team

A FEW REASONS TO WORK WITH US

data.title: Data Engineer
data.description:
Role: Data Engineer

Location: Manchester – Hybrid working

Salary: £44k OTE

PHMG is continuing to develop and mature its data capability, focusing on modernising our data platform and enhancing the way we work. As part of this continued development, we are looking to strengthen our Data Engineering team and maximise the value from the wealth of data held across the organisation. 

We are looking for a Data Engineer to help design, build and maintain reliable, scalable data solutions. Working as part of an established Data Engineering team, you will contribute to the development of our data platform, strengthen engineering practices and help improve the quality and reliability of data across the organisation. 

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Data Engineer with strong SQL and Python skills to work with modern cloud data technologies, contribute to our engineering standards and play a part in delivering and evolving PHMG's Data Strategy. 
 

What you will do: 

  • Design, build and maintain scalable, reliable and maintainable data pipelines and datasets.
  • Play a key role in developing and improving our Microsoft Fabric data platform.
  • Contribute to the design and development of data warehouse, lakehouse and data integration solutions.
  • Apply strong engineering practices across source control, CI/CD, testing, documentation, monitoring and error handling.
  • Develop and maintain data models to support reporting, analytics and wider business use cases.
  • Collaborate with other Data Engineers and technical teams to improve data architecture, platform performance and engineering processes.
  • Work closely with Reporting, Insights and Data Science teams to understand requirements and deliver effective data solutions.

 

The person we are looking for will have the following experience:  

  • Strong SQL skills, including experience writing and optimising complex queries and data transformations.
  • Strong Python skills, with practical experience using Python for data engineering, data processing or automation.
  • Proven experience designing and building data pipelines, with a strong understanding of modern ETL/ELT practices.
  • Experience working with modern cloud data platforms and orchestration technologies. Experience within the Microsoft data ecosystem would be advantageous.
  • Experience of data modelling for reporting and analytics, including dimensional modelling and designing datasets for downstream consumption.
  • Experience with modern engineering practices including Git-based source control, CI/CD, testing, monitoring and error handling.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working effectively within agile, cross-functional teams.

 

Nice-to-have experience: 

  • Microsoft Fabric, including Warehouse, Lakehouse and Data Factory capabilities.
  • Infrastructure as Code approaches and tools such as Terraform.
  • API-based, event-driven or operational system integrations, such as Salesforce.

 

The Team 

The Data Engineering team sits within PHMG's wider Data function and is responsible for building and maintaining the platforms, pipelines and data models that underpin reporting, analytics and data science across the organisation. 

The team works closely with Reporting & Insights, Data Science, IT and other business teams to make data reliable, accessible and useful across the business. We are continuing to strengthen our engineering practices, improve our platform and build greater resilience and consistency across the data estate. 

 

Why PHMG Tech?  

The IT, Development and Data functions within PHMG continue to evolve how we use technology and data to deliver value to the business. We want to build an open, collaborative culture where people communicate honestly, support each other and take pride in delivering good work. 

 

About PHMG: 

Established in 1998, PHMG has grown from a renowned Manchester-based business to the world's leading audio branding agency – working with 36,000 clients in 54 countries across the globe. This expansive client list includes household names of the calibre of Samsung, Audi and Adidas, as well as SMEs in every sector of the global market. We give each of them a stellar production that combines creative copy, world-class voice artistry and an exclusive Brand-Sound-Track™ – strengthening their business identity in the most memorable, emotive way.

data.title: Product Manager - Identity for AI
data.description:
About Ping Identity: 

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it. 

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear. 

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work. 

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management. 

We're hiring a Product Manager to lead the evolution of Ping Identity's Identity for AI solution: a strategic product initiative focused on securing and enabling Agentic AI. In this high-impact role, you'll help define how AI agents securely access resources and shape the capabilities that will be foundational to Ping's platform in the AI era.

Ping's Identity for AI solution is already in the market and gaining strong traction with global enterprises. Working across product, engineering, sales, and go-to-market teams, you'll help deliver innovative capabilities that solve real customer challenges. You'll partner with teams across Ping that move fast, listen closely, and obsess over user value. 

The Product Manager role is an important part of Ping Identity's worldwide go to market strategy. Reporting to the Group Product Manager for Identity for AI, you'll drive product execution by defining requirements, managing the roadmap and backlog, and turning strategy into customer value. You'll serve as the voice of the customer for engineering while providing product expertise and use-case guidance to the field.

At Ping, we're using AI to accelerate delivery, improve decision-making, and increase effectiveness across the product lifecycle - giving you the opportunity to help shape how AI transforms product management itself.

What You'll Do

  • Identify and prioritize the development of features and capabilities required for Identity for AI product growth, and influence and implement the product strategy for Ping's Identity for AI solution.
  • Gather market, customer, prospect, and partner input to understand customer scenarios and technical requirements, uncover pain points and unmet needs, and ensure product-market fit for Ping's Identity for AI solution.
  • Provide detailed input into the product planning process and priority of features for communication to engineering.
  • Develop technical requirements and collaborate closely with engineering, design, marketing, and sales to build, launch, and refine high-quality and polished features that meet customer and market needs.
  • Perform market analysis, identifying industry trends, strategic needs, emerging protocols/frameworks, and competitive pressures to inform product direction.
  • Become a subject matter expert on Identity for AI, enabling Ping's sales and solution engineering teams and helping to scale understanding and adoption of Ping's Identity for AI vision and solution internally and externally.
  • Leverage AI tools to improve efficiency and effectiveness across product management workflows, including research, analysis, documentation, prioritization, and cross-functional communication.

What You'll Bring

  • Cloud computing experience  in a product management or engineering role.
  • Strong knowledge of identity and access management, zero trust architectures, identity standards and technology.
  • Hands on experience with AI frameworks and how to deploy them at scale
  • Experience creating first-class product experiences for Developers and IT administrators
  • Prior experience developing products from Zero-to-One, demonstrating comfort with nascent, emerging and fast-moving domains.
  • A history of managing product development lifecycles to consistently deliver high-quality releases.
  • Comfort in discussing product capabilities and market relevance to end-users, partners, engineers, analysts.
  • Ability to synthesize technical and market information into crisp recommendations and roadmaps, and to present and defend recommendations to a variety of audiences.
  • Ability to create effective relationships, influence and collaborate internally and externally at all organizational levels.
  • Proven strength solving technical problems by driving cross-team collaboration, ownership, and accountability.
  • High-agency and extreme ownership: You consistently take initiative, drive progress without waiting for direction, and assume accountability for outcomes
  • Creative and enthusiasm to boost efficiency with AI, through workflows, tools, or automation.

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We're growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that's who we want to succeed with every day. 

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits: 

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule 
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement 
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations) 

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone's individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Dafür suchen wir dich – zur Verstärkung unseres Backend- & AI-Teams als Backend Developer / AI Engineer

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und betreibst die Backend-Services hinter unseren KI-Assistenten, die unsere Agenten und ihr Wissen für alle Kundenprojekte bereitstellen
  • Du baust und verbesserst die Suche, die zu jeder Frage die passenden Inhalte findet, und deren Aufbereitung zur Antwort

  • Du hältst die Daten verschiedener Kunden sauber getrennt und sorgst dafür, dass Zugriffsrechte zuverlässig greifen
  • Du entscheidest über die Architektur mit und arbeitest eng mit dem Frontend-, Daten- und KI-Team zusammen

Qualifikation

Dein Profil

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung mit einer modernen, typsicheren Programmiersprache (z. B. Go, Rust, Java, C# o. Ä.)

  • Eigenständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Freude an Teamarbeit

Nice to have (aber kein Muss):

  • Kenntnisse in semantischer Suche, Ranking-Verfahren und Datenaufbereitung für KI
  • Erfahrung mit dem Betrieb eigener Recheninfrastruktur (z. B. GPU-gestützt)
  • Verständnis für europäische Cloud- und Datenschutz-Anforderungen
  • Erfahrung mit Multi-Tenant-Architekturen und Zugriffs- / Rechtekonzepten

Was du nicht machen musst:

  • Kein Frontend-Development und kein Pixel-Feintuning von UIs
  • Kein klassisches Website- / CMS-Building

Benefits

Warum i-gelb?

  • Zukunftstechnologien: KI-Anwendungen, semantische Suche und eigene KI-Infrastruktur
  • Sinnstiftende Projekte: Unsere Kunden sind Kirchen, soziale Organisationen und öffentliche Einrichtungen

  • Moderne Ausstattung: Neue Hardware, aktuelle Tools, kreative Freiräume
  • Angenehme Atmosphäre: Flache Hierarchien, nettes Team, kostenlose Snacks & Drinks
  • Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeit, Verständnis für dein Privatleben

Deine Perspektive

Bei uns entwickelst du dich weiter:

  • Von der Suche zu eigener KI-Infrastruktur
  • Von Standardlösungen zu europäischen, datenschutzkonformen KI-Systemen
  • Von einzelnen Agenten zu einer KI-Plattform für viele Kunden

Klingt spannend?

data.title: Interim/Freelance Director of IT, Security & Infrastructure (d/f/m)
data.description:
Our story:

Every year millions of people are either filing their taxes in fear or giving up on their tax refund altogether. We're working on fixing that. Our intuitive app enables anyone, regardless of education or background, to file their taxes with newfound confidence.

Spread across Germany, Spain and the UK, the team at Taxfix Group with its brands Taxfix and Steuerbot, is a compassionate group of solution-finders. We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016.

The opportunity:

Taxfix is building something most companies only talk about: a fully agentic infrastructure layer that every team in the company will depend on. And right now, IT is either the foundation that makes that possible — or the bottleneck that slows it down.

As our Director of Security & IT, you are the difference between those two outcomes. This is not a traditional IT Director role. You won't be managing tickets or keeping the lights on. You'll be building a platform function from the ground up — one that gives every hybrid human-agent team at Taxfix the speed, security, and confidence to move without friction. Reporting to our Chief People Officer and working closely with our Systems Engineer and cross-functional partners across Engineering, Legal, Finance, and People Ops, you'll define the infrastructure and security foundation that turns our agentic ambitions into reality.

The best outcome in this role isn't that IT stays out of the way — it's that IT raises the bar for how the whole organization operates. You'll set standards that others build to, make calls that shape Taxfix's security posture for years, and build the infrastructure layer that our agentic ambitions depend on. This role comes with real authority and real accountability. If you want to be the person who defines what modern IT looks like at a company that's genuinely building the future of work — this is that job.

This is an interim position on a freelance basis.


Your responsibilities:

  • Own the vision and roadmap for Taxfix's internal infrastructure and tooling layer, driving the transition from IT as a ticket-resolving function to an internal platform product that enables every hybrid human-agent team to move faster and more securely.

  • Lead and develop the IT team — including helpdesk, systems engineering, and the incoming Security & Platform Engineer — ensuring clear ownership, structured growth paths, and a high-performing team culture through a period of significant structural change.

  • Own all core IT operations: device management (MDM), identity and access management, workplace technology, SaaS tooling, third-party network provider relationship, and hardware provisioning — maintaining reliability, cost controlling and service quality while progressively raising the bar on what "good" looks like.

  • Set the security strategy and posture for Taxfix's systems and agent ecosystem, embedding security continuously into platform infrastructure rather than applying it as a gate at the end.

  • Work closely with our Systems Engineers and the agentic framework team to build and document the agentic platform layer — including secure sandboxes, credential vaults, and CI/CD pipelines — ensuring infrastructure decisions support the organisation's agentic ambitions.

  • Own IT-specific risk management, compliance controls, and audit readiness across internal systems and infrastructure, partnering with Legal, Compliance, and enterprise risk owners on GDPR/DSGVO, SOC 2, and applicable financial regulatory requirements.

  • Manage supplier relationships and lead the build and lead the build/buy/partner evaluation, making a long-term recommendation grounded in both technical and business considerations.

  • Be the business-facing voice for IT in leadership conversations — translating infrastructure and security decisions into clear business terms and building trusted relationships with Engineering, Legal, Finance, and People Ops.

  • Define and track platform health metrics, service quality, and internal adoption — including establishing internal NPS for IT services as a baseline, driving measurable reductions in ticket volume and mean time to resolution, and reporting transparently on the agentic infrastructure layer.


Your profile:

  • You have proven experience leading an IT or infrastructure function at a scale-up or regulated tech company — including ownership of core IT operations such as helpdesk, MDM, identity management, and workplace technology. You know what it takes to run these reliably while simultaneously raising the ambition of what the function can be.

  • You have built or are capable of building a platform mindset in a team that has historically operated as a support function — you understand what that shift requires culturally, structurally, and in terms of how success gets measured.

  • You bring strong enough technical depth to have credible, substantive conversations with engineers — you can interrogate technical decisions, ask the right questions, and know when to push back.

  • You are security-literate and have hands-on experience setting security strategy: you understand the threat landscape, have navigated compliance and audit obligations in a regulated environment, and know what good security posture looks like at both the infrastructure and application layer.

  • You have experience with agentic or AI infrastructure, or you bring genuine curiosity and a track record of fast learning in emerging technical domains — this space is moving quickly, and so are we.

  • You have managed vendors and external partners, including evaluating and making build/buy/outsource decisions, and you're comfortable owning those relationships end to end.

  • You are familiar with the compliance and data obligations that come with operating in a regulated environment — financial services, tax, or similar — and you've translated those obligations into practical infrastructure and process decisions.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and energised by the opportunity to help shape a function that is being designed in real time — you don't wait for a playbook; you help write it.

  • You grow the people around you: you see early-career team members and ambitious engineers as people to invest in, and you create the conditions for them to do their best work.

  • You are ego-light: you are comfortable with invisible success — the best outcome is that teams don't notice IT because everything works — and you are willing to tell leadership when a request isn't feasible and explain why in terms that land.


Why Taxfix? 

  • A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals.

  • Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions and yoga.

  • A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like.

  • Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create.

  • 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours.

  • A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts.

  • Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip.

  • Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible.

  • Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions.

  • Have a four-legged friend in your life? We’re happy to have dogs join us in the office.


Excited? So are we. Learn more about Team Taxfix on our blog and get a glimpse of our culture.

 

At Taxfix, we believe that incredible things happen when you have a wealth of perspectives and experiences. We're proudly committed to equal employment and development opportunities no matter your gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, colour, disability, or place of origin. To help mitigate any potential unconscious biases, we ask that you refrain from including your picture, age, or marital status on your CV. Let your experiences speak for themselves.

Not sure if you meet all the requirements for this role? Please apply anyway. You might bring something special to the team that we hadn't considered previously.

data.title: AI Engineer, Quality & Evals (m/f/x)
data.description:
About us

We’re Cortea, a Berlin startup transforming audits with AI. Manual, document-heavy audits waste expert time while demand keeps rising. Our AI-powered software and specialized AI agents remove the repetitive work so auditors can focus on judgment.

Backed by top-tier VCs with >15m EUR funding, with a working product and paying customers, we’re rapidly scaling.

We value first-principles thinking, speed, trust, and kindness. We build side by side in our Berlin office.

Your Role

We are looking for an engineer with strong backend, data, and AI systems experience to build the evaluation and observability foundation for production-grade LLM agents used in complex audit workflows.

This role sits at the intersection of backend engineering, data infrastructure, and AI quality. You will build the evaluation systems that power our multimodal retrieval agents and continuously improve critical quality metrics across current and future pipelines.

You’ll work at the edge of applied AI and information retrieval, building multimodal agentic pipelines and solving hard context and agent-harness engineering problems.

This is not a traditional analytics, BI, or dashboarding role. You should expect to write production code, design data architecture, work inside backend systems, and directly improve the quality, cost, reliability, and performance of LLM-based agents.

What you’ll do

You will help build and operate the technical systems around our AI agents, with a focus on data infrastructure, evaluation, observability, and optimization. You will:

  • Build online and offline evaluation systems for LLM agents, including pipelines that use golden datasets, ground-truth data, human review workflows, and experiment results.

  • Create automated quality gates so changes to prompts, context, models, or agent logic can be tested before reaching production.

  • Analyze large volumes of agent traces and executions in columnar and analytical databases such as BigQuery or ClickHouse to identify failure modes, quality regressions, latency issues, reliability gaps, and cost optimization opportunities.

  • Build reliable data retention and replay mechanisms for long-term analysis of production agent behavior.

  • Manage observability tools for tracing, monitoring, debugging, and experiment management of our audit agents.

  • Team up with backend engineers to improve the speed and reliability of our retrieval and reasoning agents.

You will fit into the role if you...

  • Have strong Python and/or backend engineering experience.

  • Have a solid understanding of how LLM and agent systems are evaluated—including deterministic checks, ground truth, LLM-as-judge, human review, and quality metrics—and can reason about when each approach is appropriate.

  • Have deployed and operated systems in the cloud, ideally on GCP.

  • Have hands-on experience building end-to-end retrieval or ML pipeline evaluation systems and using LLM observability or experimentation tools such as Braintrust, MLflow, Langfuse, or Weights & Biases.

  • Are comfortable working with analytical databases, data warehouses, columnar stores, and high-volume event or trace data.

  • Understand system design, reliability, observability, monitoring, logging, debugging, and operational trade-offs.

  • Bring senior-level engineering judgment: you can make architectural decisions, communicate trade-offs, and build systems that other engineers can extend.

  • Are comfortable with ambiguity, able to reason from first principles, and excited to build infrastructure for AI systems that are actively used in production.

Nice-to-haves that are a plus:

  • Designing data pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, event-processing systems, or feedback loops for production data.

  • Building infrastructure around LLM-based products or agentic systems, including optimizing LLM usage, context windows, reasoning tokens, or model selection.

  • Working with production traces from complex distributed systems.

  • Building internal platforms for engineers, domain experts, or operations teams.

  • Using workflow orchestration systems such as Temporal or similar.

  • Familiarity with audit, finance, compliance, or other high-accuracy domains.

  • Experience in an early-stage startup or fast-moving engineering environment.

No-one checks every box. If you’ve shipped retrieval systems and like owning evaluations and pipelines, let’s talk.

What we offer

  • High impact & growth: Shape strategy at a scaling AI startup from day one.

  • Mission-driven culture: Ambitious team valuing first-principles thinking and bold ideas.

  • Attractive compensation: competitive salary plus significant equity.

  • Best tools for the job: Generous coding tools budget so you can use the best tools for the job.

  • Startup perks: Flexible vacation, team lunches, retreats, central Berlin office.

Interview process

  • First Call — Intro to Cortea with Liza

  • Second Call — Technical interview with Vlad

  • Third Call — Deep dive into our culture with our Co-Founder Philipp

  • On-site Day (Berlin) — Meet the team and work on a real problem together

We’re an equal-opportunity team and encourage women and underrepresented groups to apply.

dida ist eine der führenden Machine Learning Agenturen mit Aufträgen und Projekten in der Wissenschaft, der Industrie und dem öffentlichen Sektor. data.title: Product Manager
data.description:
Your mission

To support our growing team, we are looking for an experienced Product Manager. In this role, you will take a strategic and hands-on approach to defining the product vision and expanding our product suite. You will develop frameworks and processes that bring together insights from engineers, executives, and customers to strengthen our cutting-edge, easy-to-use, high-performance AI infrastructure design and management platform.

  • Develop the multi-year vision and roadmap for our AI Scheduling product, from job queuing and resource allocation to latency optimization and reliability at scale.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, infrastructure, and platform teams to define and deliver capabilities that enterprise and developer customers rely on every day.
  • Engage directly with customers to identify unmet needs, validate product direction, and turn complex or conflicting input into clear product decisions.
  • Monitor the competitive and technical landscape, including distributed systems, orchestration tools, and AI workload patterns, and translate relevant trends into roadmap implications.
  • Work with leadership to support product launches, roadmap reviews, and the broader product narrative.
  • Create tight feedback loops between customers and engineering to continuously improve performance, usability, and reliability.
  • Support go-to-market activities by contributing to product messaging, documentation, and technical content, including blogs, white papers, and presentations.


Your profile

 This role is open to candidates based in Germany who are able to work in a hybrid setup from our Heidelberg office, or candidates based in the San Francisco Bay Area. 

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including significant ownership of infrastructure, platform, or developer tooling products.
  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent hands-on technical experience.
  • Proven track record of defining and delivering multi-year product roadmaps, not just quarterly plans.
  • Product management experience with cloud or cluster management technologies such as Kubernetes, OpenStack, Slurm, VMware, or similar platforms.
  • Working understanding of machine learning systems, including compute hardware, communication layers, and AI software toolchains.
  • Working understanding of common machine learning software, including models, inference engines, orchestration tools, and typical user and developer workflows.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and able to make clear decisions with incomplete information.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineers, executives, and enterprise customers.
  • Comfortable working as an individual contributor, with impact driven by insight, ownership, and cross-functional influence rather than team size.
  • Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams without losing quality or momentum.
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 30% between our German and US locations, as business needs require.

Nice to have

  • Experience in an AI/ML infrastructure or MLOps environment, including an understanding of how scheduling supports training, inference, and evaluation pipelines.
  • A portfolio of technical writing, product specifications, or public content demonstrating an ability to communicate complex topics clearly.
  • Measurable outcomes you can point to and own, such as shipped products, adoption metrics, customer wins, or performance improvements.


Why us?

  • Build something big: Help build and scale a fast-growing AI infrastructure startup.
  • Pay & perks: Competitive compensation, performance-based incentives, a subsidized Deutschlandticket, and access to a discount portal.
  • Work your way: Flexible hours with hybrid and remote-friendly options.
  • Fast lanes, no red tape: Flat hierarchies and rapid decision-making mean ideas move quickly.
  • Global team: Work with a diverse, international team across Germany and the US.
  • Modern offices: Well-equipped locations near Heidelberg Hauptbahnhof and in the San Francisco Bay Area.
  • Top setup: Your choice of high-quality hardware and equipment.

  • sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • die Bereitschaft, 16–20 Stunden pro Woche zu arbeiten, in den Semesterferien auch gerne mehr.

data.title: Procurement Director (m/f/d)
data.description:
About HOLY

  • HOLY is the soft drink revolution: With our powdered drinks HOLY Energy®, HOLY Hydration®, HOLY Iced Tea®, HOLY Milkshake® and HOLY Syrup Bottle® you get amazing taste across 50+ flavors while maintaining a good conscience—for your body & the environment.
  • Over 2M loyal customers: Started in a shared apartment by three best friends, we have scaled to Europe's fastest growing consumer brand—and our cult-like community, the HOLY Squad, loves it: 4.6 stars on reviews.io speak for themselves.
  • From D2C to Global Omnichannel: In less than four years, we've profitably scaled HOLY to more than €180M D2C revenue in DACH, FR, UK and PL. Now scaling our retail business, we're on an exciting transition to becoming a true omnichannel rocketship.
  • We are still just getting started: Backed by the world's best consumer investors, we aim to revolutionize the soft drink industry and build a generational love brand: tastier, healthier & more sustainable. Our team of 170+ people aims high (Coca-Cola, we're coming for you!).


About the Position

As Procurement Director, you will build one of HOLY's most important competitive advantages: a world-class supplier ecosystem that enables us to scale faster, improve margins and consistently deliver outstanding products to our customers.

Procurement at HOLY is far more than buying ingredients. You will own our sourcing strategy across ingredients, packaging, merchandising and co-manufacturing while continuously improving cost, quality, supplier performance, flexibility and speed.

This is a highly strategic leadership position reporting directly to our COO, Markus. You will work closely with Product Development, Supply Chain Planning, Operations, Finance and our founders to build supplier partnerships capable of supporting HOLY's ambitious growth journey toward becoming a global consumer brand.

We are not necessarily looking for a traditional procurement leader. We are looking for an exceptional builder with outstanding commercial judgment who enjoys solving complex business problems and creating long-term competitive advantages.

If you combine strategic thinking with a hands-on mindset, thrive in fast-paced environments and enjoy building things from scratch, this role is for you.

Responsibilities: 

Strategic procurement

  • Own HOLY's sourcing strategy across ingredients, packaging, merchandising and co-manufacturing
  • Develop category strategies that improve competitiveness, resilience and long-term scalability
  • Drive structural COGS improvements through strategic sourcing, commercial excellence and value engineering
  • Identify new sourcing opportunities, technologies and supplier capabilities to strengthen HOLY's competitive position
  • Build long-term strategic partnerships with HOLY's key suppliers
  • Develop suppliers across capacity, quality, innovation, flexibility and operational excellence
  • Ensure our suppliers scale alongside HOLY's ambitious growth plans
  • Establish HOLY as a preferred customer through trust, transparency and professional supplier management
  • Strengthen our supplier ecosystem through selective onboarding of new partners and pragmatic multi-sourcing where it creates value
Supply Chain & Operational Excellence
  • Improve end-to-end supply chain performance by reducing lead times, increasing supplier responsiveness and improving planning reliability
  • Partner closely with Supply Chain Planning and Operations to align supplier capabilities with demand forecasts, inventory targets and growth plans
  • Improve working capital through stronger commercial terms, better supplier collaboration and optimized replenishment models
  • Support the development of a scalable and resilient manufacturing network
Supplier Performance & Quality
  • Own supplier performance across quality, OTIF, responsiveness, compliance and continuous improvement
  • Establish structured Supplier Business Reviews, measurable KPIs and clear accountability with strategic suppliers
  • Proactively identify and mitigate supply risks before they impact the business
  • Ensure suppliers consistently meet HOLY's quality, food safety and regulatory standards
Leadership & Organization Building
  • Lead and develop HOLY's Strategic Procurement and Operational Buying teams
  • Build a high-performance organization with strong commercial capabilities, clear ownership and a continuous improvement mindset
  • Develop future leaders and continuously raise the maturity of HOLY's procurement function
  • Build scalable processes, systems and ways of working that support HOLY's growth


About You

We care more about your ability to solve complex business problems than about having followed a traditional career path.

You might come from Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Supply Chain, Operations, Strategy Consulting, Commercial or another highly analytical business function.

Ideally, you bring several of the following experience & expertise:

  • 5–10+ years of experience in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Consulting, Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial or another analytical leadership role
  • Outstanding structured problem-solving skills and the ability to translate complex challenges into pragmatic solutions
  • Experience working in fast-paced, high-growth or entrepreneurial environments where ownership and speed matter
  • Strong commercial judgment and experience negotiating with suppliers, partners or senior stakeholders
  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional initiatives and deliver measurable business impact
  • Experience building scalable processes, organizations and ways of working
  • Experience leading and developing teams is a strong plus
  • Exposure to manufacturing, FMCG, food & beverage or consumer goods is beneficial but not required
  • Excellent communication skills in English (German is a plus but not required) 
Mindset & Qualities: 
  • You are a builder who enjoys creating structures, teams and processes from scratch
  • You combine strategic thinking with strong execution skills and are comfortable getting hands-on
  • You have exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities and can quickly structure complex situations
  • You take ownership, move fast and thrive in environments with high autonomy and ambiguity
  • You build trust easily and can influence suppliers, stakeholders and teams through strong communication and judgment
  • You are commercially minded and always look for ways to create measurable business impact


Our Offering

In today's job market, A-players have many options to choose from. As part of our offer, we prioritise providing a productive working environment and opportunities for growth. In addition to competitive compensation, including company shares, you can expect:

  • A successful and growing company: Join a company that has been growing profitable and quickly for the last 36+ months and have raised a series B, while many other e-commerce companies are struggling.
  • Huge impact: Enjoy huge impact to shape HOLY’s internationalisation in a top market.
  • Awesome team: Join an awesome team of colleagues who are ambitious, funny, down-to-earth, and authentic. Get to know us and see for yourself!
  • Top product: Marketing is important, but a good product is essential. Our differentiated soft drinks have won over 2.5 million customers. Check out our reviews.io reviews or contact us for free samples.
  • Startup culture: Join a startup culture that values flat hierarchies, fast pace, and personal development. With us, you can make a real impact.
  • Perfect setup: Enjoy a perfect setup that includes all the requirements of a modern employer, such as a central office in Berlin Prenzlauerberg, flexible working hours, and much more.
  • Competitive comp. + equity: Join us at a pivotal stage of hypergrowth. We offer a strong salary and meaningful equity—giving you the chance to share in our current success and benefit from the massive upside as we scale.
  • How we support your growth: flexible hours, 28 vacation days, 30 work-from-abroad days, €1,500 learning budget, Urban Sports Club membership, public transport subsidy, and biannual 360° feedback tied to your compensation.
Find out more about HOLY and our team on our careers page.


The Process

As we are experiencing rapid growth and have ambitious plans, the optimal start date for the position is today. Nonetheless, we are prepared to patiently await the arrival of the ideal candidate, recognizing that quality ultimately yields the best results.

  1. Getting to know you: A 30-minute introductory conversation with Lutza, our Talent Acquisition Lead to get to know each other and discuss your experience, motivation and the role.
  2. Hiring Manager Interview: A deep-dive discussion with Markus, our COO about your experience, leadership style and how you approach complex business challenges.
  3. Case Study: You will receive a business case to demonstrate your strategic thinking, analytical approach and ability to solve real HOLY challenges.
  4. Advanced Discussion in our office, the HOLY Temple: Present and discuss your case with key stakeholders while getting to know our team and our way of working.
  5. Founder Interview: A final conversation with Fredi, one of HOLY's founders to ensure a strong mutual fit.
  6. Offer & Decision: If everything aligns, we will make you an offer and hopefully welcome you to the HOLY team.
Typically, this process takes around 2–3 weeks.

data.title: Quality Manager – Quality Control & Quality Assurance (all genders)
data.description:
About the role:

We are a niche beauty startup dedicated to developing high-quality cosmetic products with a strong focus on natural ingredients and modern formulation science. We combine scientific standards with a conscious approach to sustainability, ingredient transparency, and performance-driven skincare.


So, what can you expect to work on?

  • Own incoming quality control for raw materials and packaging, including sampling plans, specification checks, and supplier certificate of analysis review.

  • Manage batch release: reviewing production records, in-process checks, and finished-product testing before a batch is cleared for sale.

  • Coordinate microbiological, stability, and preservative-efficacy (challenge) testing with external laboratories, and interpret results against acceptance criteria.

  • Lead investigation of out-of-specification results and contamination events, including root cause analysis, containment, and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) plans, in coordination with suppliers.

  • Maintain and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for quality control and quality assurance processes.

  • Own the customer complaint process: logging, root cause analysis, corrective action, and closing the loop with customer service and production.

  • Maintain quality records and documentation in line with ISO 22716 (Cosmetics GMP) principles.

  • Support internal audits of quality processes and prepare documentation for external audits and certification bodies.

  • Evaluate new raw materials and suppliers from a quality and testing perspective ahead of onboarding, working closely with Sourcing and Development.

  • Act as the day-to-day quality contact for Production and Development, flagging quality risks before they reach the market.


What you offer us

  • 3+ years of experience in Quality Control or Quality Assurance within cosmetics, personal care, or a comparable regulated industry.

  • Degree in a natural science field (Chemistry, Cosmetic Science, Biology, or comparable), or equivalent hands-on experience.

  • Working knowledge of ISO 22716 (Cosmetics GMP) and cosmetic microbiological testing and challenge testing (e.g. ISO 11930) principles.

  • Practical experience with root cause analysis and CAPA processes.

  • Comfortable reviewing batch records, certificates of analysis, and laboratory test reports independently.

  • Experience working with external testing laboratories and coordinating results against acceptance criteria.

data.title: Chemical Laboratory Assistant / Lab Technician (f/m/d) Analytics & Synthesis
data.description:
Your mission

Join aevoloop, a deep-tech startup in Leipzig, where we are pioneering the next generation of circular plastics. We are looking for a hands-on Chemical Technical Assistant (CTA) or Lab Technician who takes pride in their lab work. In this role, your primary focus will be on the precise "measuring" (analytics) of our materials, while reliably supporting the team with "making" (synthesis).

  • Analytics & Characterization: You are the analytical core of our lab. You routinely perform instrumental and wet-chemical analyses to precisely characterisze our next-generation materials (e.g., NMR, IR spectroscopy, DSC, titrations).

  • Synthesis Execution: You support syntheses (specifically polycondensations) on a bench and pilot scale, reliably and accurately executing reactions according to established standard operating procedures (SOPs).

  • Daily Lab Routine & Excellence: You ensure smooth lab operations. This includes preparing and maintaining glassware, sample preparation, material drying, and general lab organization.

  • Precision & Documentation: You ensure our measurement data is rock-solid. This includes regular calibration of analytical instruments, maintaining detailed lab journals, and assisting in drafting clear SOPs.

  • Safety & Organization: You maintain a safe, high-standard working environment (GLP) and ensure analytical equipment is always ready for the next run.


Your profile

  • Education: Successfully completed vocational training as a CTA (Chemical Technical Assistant), Chemielaborant, or a similar technical background. Academic degrees or Techniker qualifications are considered, but this is a hands-on technical role where practical bench experience is our top priority.

  • Analytical Expertise: Strong practical experience in general instrumental and wet-chemical analytics (especially NMR, IR, DSC, titration). Experience in specialized polymer testing (e.g., MFR/MFI, tensile testing) or prior experience in a plastics laboratory is a major plus!

  • Synthesis Experience: Experience in carrying out organic syntheses safely according to protocol (SOPs). Specialized knowledge of polymers or reactors is advantageous, but not mandatory—we are happy to train you.

  • Technical Routine: You feel "at home" in the lab. You are confident operating analytical instruments, preparing samples, and performing routine instrument calibrations.

  • Mindset: You bring a "maker" mentality. You are detail-oriented, reliable, and enjoy the dynamic, collaborative energy of a scaling startup.

  • Languages: Working knowledge of English (sufficient for technical documentation and day-to-day team communication) is required. German is a plus, but not necessary.


Why us?

  • Real Impact: Help redesign plastics for a truly circular economy.

  • Startup Mindset: Flat hierarchies, fast decisions and early responsibility as we scale.

  • Team Culture: Join a team of curious minds that challenge each other, collaborate openly and celebrate progress together.

  • Growth & Learning: Steep learning curves, regular feedback and room to grow with the company.

  • Well-being Perks – Hansefit membership and fresh snacks and beverages your overall health and well-being.


Contact

data.title: Werkstudent B2B Sales & Business Development – AI Startup (m/w/d)
data.description:
Deine Rolle:

Umfang: 20 Std./Woche (befristet)
Vergütung: 16,50 € pro Stunde + attraktiver Performance-Bonus ohne Obergrenze

Du möchtest lernen, wie moderner B2B-Vertrieb wirklich funktioniert und mit deiner Arbeit direkten Einfluss auf das Wachstum eines AI-Startups haben? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.
Als Werkstudent:in im B2B Sales & Business Development unterstützt du unser Sales Team dabei, neue Kunden für unsere AI-SaaS-Lösung zu gewinnen. Du führst Gespräche mit Entscheidern, entwickelst dein Verkaufsgeschick kontinuierlich weiter und siehst unmittelbar, welchen Impact deine Arbeit auf unser Wachstum hat.


Deine Mission bei uns:

  • Du identifizierst potenzielle B2B-Kunden und kontaktierst eigenständig relevante Entscheider. 
  • Du begeisterst Interessenten für unsere AI-Lösung und vereinbarst qualifizierte Product Demos. 
  • Du erkennst Geschäftspotenziale, stellst die richtigen Fragen und entwickelst ein Gespür für erfolgreiche Vertriebsgespräche. 
  • Du dokumentierst deine Aktivitäten zuverlässig im CRM und arbeitest eng mit unserem Sales Team zusammen. 
  • Du unterstützt zusätzlich unseren LinkedIn-Outreach über Sales Navigator und begleitest Follow-ups bis zur Terminvereinbarung.


Damit passt du zu uns:

  • Du bist aktuell an einer Hochschule oder Universität eingeschrieben.
  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau sowie sichere Englischkenntnisse, um dich im internationalen Arbeitsumfeld souverän zu verständigen.
  • Du hast keine Scheu davor, auf Menschen zuzugehen und gehst offen auf neue Gesprächspartner zu. 
  • Du lässt dich von einem "Nein" nicht entmutigen, sondern siehst es als Teil des Lernprozesses. 
  • Du bist ehrgeizig und hast Lust, jeden Tag ein Stück besser zu werden. 
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und behältst auch bei mehreren Leads den Überblick. 
  • Idealerweise interessierst du dich für Technologie, KI oder moderne Softwarelösungen.


Darauf kannst du dich freuen:

  • Attraktiver Performance-Bonus ohne Obergrenze: Neben deinem Stundenlohn belohnen wir erfolgreiche Product Demos mit einem leistungsabhängigen Quartalsbonus. Je mehr qualifizierte Termine du vereinbarst, desto höher fällt dein Bonus aus – nach oben gibt es keine Grenze.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten – Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag so, wie es zu dir passt.
  • Wir schaffen ein inspirierendes Arbeitsumfeld – Unser modernes Büro, nur wenige Minuten vom Berliner Gendarmenmarkt entfernt, bietet dir eine top Lage und eine produktive Atmosphäre. Dazu gibt’s hochwertige Apple-Hardware, damit du immer bestens ausgestattet bist.
  • Wir fördern Teamspirit & Spaß – Regelmäßige Teamevents - von Bootstouren über Exit-Rooms bis hin zum Kletterwald und Vision-Workshops - sorgen für Abwechslung und stärken unseren Zusammenhalt.
  • Mental Strength & Wellbeing – Dein Kopf ist genauso wichtig wie dein Skillset! Wir bei Cito wissen: Erfolg beginnt im Kopf. Deshalb bieten wir dir Mental-Health-Angebote und Workshops, um deine mentale Stärke, Resilienz und innere Balance zu stärken.
  • Wir unterstützen deine Karriere – Mit unserem transparenten High Performance Modell hast du echte Entwicklungsperspektiven, die du mit deiner Führungskraft zweimal im Jahr intensiv gestaltest.
  • Wir kümmern uns um dein Wohlbefinden – Ob Unterstützung bei Elternzeitanträgen oder einfach ein offenes Ohr – bei uns wirst du nicht allein gelassen.
  • Wir belohnen dich mit attraktiven Extras – Von einem Corporate Benefit Program mit Rabatten u.a. bei Zalando, Apple, Aida, bis hin zur kostenlosen Urban Sports Club Mitgliedschaft – du profitierst von einer Vielzahl an Vergünstigungen für Sport, Freizeit und Shopping.
  • Wir setzen auf Integrität & Compliance – Integrität, Vertrauen und Verantwortung sind feste Bestandteile unserer Unternehmenskultur.

data.title: Senior BI Developer (m/w/d)
data.description:
Für ein etabliertes, technologieorientiertes Unternehmen suchen wir im Rahmen der Direktvermittlung über PRIME HR Agentur® einen erfahrenen Senior BI Developer (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt auf Microsoft Fabric, Power BI und Azure.

In dieser Position entwickeln Sie moderne Datenlösungen, die Unternehmen dabei unterstützen, aus verlässlichen Daten konkrete Erkenntnisse und bessere Geschäftsentscheidungen abzuleiten. Neben klassischen BI-Lösungen spielen dabei auch KI-gestützte Anwendungen, Automatisierungen, Bots, Copilots und AI Agents eine zunehmend wichtige Rolle.

Sie arbeiten eigenverantwortlich an anspruchsvollen Kundenprojekten und stehen dabei auch direkt mit technischen und fachlichen Ansprechpartnern auf Kundenseite im Austausch.

Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung moderner BI- und Datenlösungen auf Basis von Microsoft Fabric, Power BI und Azure
  • Aufbau und Betreuung von Lakehouses, Data Warehouses, Datenpipelines und Notebooks
  • Entwicklung leistungsfähiger Power-BI-Modelle, Reports und DAX-Berechnungen
  • Erstellung und Optimierung von SQL-basierten Datenstrukturen und Datenmodellen
  • Überführung fachlicher Anforderungen in konkrete technische Umsetzungsschritte
  • Eigenständige Abstimmung technischer Fragestellungen mit Kunden aus IT und Fachbereichen
  • Planung und Einschätzung des Entwicklungsaufwands sowie strukturierte Umsetzung innerhalb agiler Projektteams
  • Entwicklung, Test, Dokumentation und produktive Bereitstellung von Datenprodukten
  • Einsatz moderner KI-Tools zur Optimierung von Entwicklung, Analyse, Dokumentation und QualitätssicherungKonzeption und Umsetzung von KI-basierten Datenprodukten für konkrete Business-AnwendungsfälleIdentifikation und Erprobung sinnvoller Einsatzmöglichkeiten für Automatisierungen, Bots, Copilots und AI Agents
  • Überführung erfolgreicher KI-Prototypen in sichere, wartbare und produktionsfähige Lösungen
  • Arbeit mit Versionsverwaltung und kollaborativen Entwicklungsprozessen, idealerweise mit Git und Azure DevOps
  • Frühzeitiges Erkennen und Kommunizieren von Risiken, Datenproblemen oder unklaren AnforderungenIdentifikation von Optimierungspotenzialen in bestehenden Datenlandschaften
  • Dokumentation von Best Practices und Weitergabe des eigenen Know-hows innerhalb des Teams

Qualifikation

Sie verbinden ausgeprägte technische Kompetenz mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich zu vermitteln. Auch im direkten Austausch mit Kunden treten Sie sicher auf und übernehmen Verantwortung für Ihre technischen Themen.

Idealerweise bringen Sie mit:

  • Mindestens 4 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der BI- oder Datenplattform-Entwicklung
  • Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und/oder fachlichen Stakeholdern
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Azure-Datenumfeld, insbesondere Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory oder Synapse
  • Praxiserfahrung mit Lakehouse- und Data-Warehouse-Konzepten
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Power BI, insbesondere Datenmodellierung, DAX und Reporting
  • Sehr gute SQL-Kenntnisse
  • Sicherer Umgang mit dimensionaler Datenmodellierung und Star-Schema-Konzepten
  • Erfahrung mit ETL-/ELT-Prozessen, Datenpipelines und Notebook-basierten Workflows
  • Erfahrung in agilen Entwicklungsumgebungen und der Arbeit mit User Stories, Aufwandsschätzungen und Sprint-Zielen
  • Kenntnisse in Git und modernen kollaborativen Entwicklungsprozessen
  • Erfahrung mit Testing, Deployment und Betrieb produktiver Datenlösungen
  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Einen routinierten und verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit modernen KI-Tools wie beispielsweise Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Codex oder vergleichbaren Lösungen

Besonders interessant sind zusätzlich

  • Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung und Einführung KI-gestützter Datenprodukte
  • Kenntnisse aktueller LLMs und Small Language Models
  • Erfahrung mit LLM-APIs, Agenten-Orchestrierung oder Automatisierungsplattformen
  • Kenntnisse in Tools wie n8n, Make, Claude Code oder vergleichbaren Technologien
  • Erfahrung darin, KI-Prototypen in sichere und langfristig wartbare Produktivlösungen zu überführen
  • Kenntnisse in Databricks
  • Erfahrung mit Python oder PySpark
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse ab B2-Niveau
  • Erfahrung in einem kundenorientierten Projektumfeld
  • Bereitschaft, technologische Entwicklungen aktiv zu verfolgen und gewonnene Erkenntnisse mit dem Team zu teilen

Benefits

Was Sie erwartet

  • Eine anspruchsvolle Senior-Position mit hohem technischem Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Direkter Austausch mit Kunden und die Möglichkeit, eigene technische Themen maßgeblich voranzutreiben
  • Moderne Technologien rund um Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure und Artificial Intelligence
  • Die Möglichkeit, Ihre Kenntnisse im Bereich LLMs, SLMs, Automatisierung und AI Agents gezielt auszubauen
  • Langfristig angelegte Kundenprojekte und ein abwechslungsreiches technologisches Umfeld
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Tech Leads und Projektverantwortlichen
  • Ein Umfeld, in dem Eigenverantwortung und technische Qualität einen hohen Stellenwert haben
  • Attraktive und marktgerechte Vergütung abhängig von Erfahrung und Standort
  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in Richtung Solution Architecture, Technical Leadership oder Delivery Leadership
  • Eine langfristige Perspektive in einem wachsenden Technologieumfeld

Ihr möglicher Entwicklungspfad

Die Position startet bewusst mit einem starken Fokus auf hands-on technische Umsetzung. Bei entsprechender Entwicklung können sukzessive weiterführende Aufgaben in den Bereichen Solution Architecture, technische Führung, Projektsteuerung oder Entwicklung neuer Kundenlösungen übernommen werden.

Was Sie in den ersten Monaten erreichen können

Nach den ersten 3 Monaten:

  • Sie kennen Ihre Kunden, deren Prozesse und die relevanten Datenstrukturen.
  • Sie übernehmen eigenständig abrechenbare Projektaufgaben.
  • Ihre entwickelten Lösungen sind getestet, dokumentiert und produktionsbereit.
  • Sie wenden etablierte Entwicklungs- und KI-Arbeitsweisen sicher an.
  • Sie haben erste konkrete Potenziale für KI-basierte Datenlösungen identifiziert.

Nach etwa 6 Monaten:

  • Kunden vertrauen Ihnen eigenständige technische Themen an.
  • Ihre Arbeit erfüllt die vereinbarten Qualitätsstandards.
  • Sie leisten einen aktiven Beitrag zur internen Wissensbasis.
  • Sie erkennen und adressieren konkrete Optimierungsmöglichkeiten in Kundenumgebungen.
  • Sie wirken an mindestens einer KI-gestützten Lösung, Automatisierung oder einem vergleichbaren Projekt mit.

Interesse geweckt?

Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung!

Die PRIME HR Agentur® begleitet Sie persönlich und diskret durch den gesamten Bewerbungsprozess und stellt den direkten Kontakt zu unserem Kunden her.

data.title: Werkstudent Data QA & Algorithm Benchmarking (m/w/d)
data.description:
Deine Mission

syte benutzt komplexe Algorithmen, die auf Basis von 3D-Punktwolken und 3D-Modellen Gebäudemetriken ausrechnen. Typische Beispiele für relevante Metriken sind Geschossfläche, Anzahl Geschosse, Volumen und Gebäudehöhen. Um schnelle Entwicklungszyklen zu gewährleisten, und Änderungen an den Algorithmen auf Knopfdruck quantitativ und automatisiert bewerten zu können, ist syte auf hochwertige QA-Daten angewiesen. Um diesen Datensatz systematisch auszubauen und zu härten und damit die Grundlage, auf der unsere Algorithmen gemessen werden, zu entwickeln, suchen wir dich als Werkstudent Data QA & Algorithm Benchmarking (m/w/d) zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Münster.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ground Truth Audit: Du evaluierst die Korrektheit bestehender Testdaten und ermittelst hierfür neue Metriken, die wir zur Evaluation unserer Algorithmen verwenden können.
  • Edge Cases jagen: Du ermittelst neue Testdaten für schwierige Gebäude (z.B. komplexe Dachformen, Bäume über den Dächern) und integrierst diese in den Gesamtdatensatz.
  • Data Sourcing: Du ermittelst potenzielle Quellen für neue Testdatensätze und integrierst diese möglichst automatisiert.
  • Benchmarking & Insights: Du führst unsere Benchmarking-Pipelines aus, um sowohl die Algorithmen als auch die Qualität der Daten quantitativ zu bewerten. Die Ergebnisse dieser Analysen visualisierst und kommunizierst du verständlich, sodass sich daraus Handlungsempfehlungen ableiten.
  • Pipeline Engineering: Du implementierst und testest Verbesserungen in den Benchmarking-Pipelines und den Parametern der Algorithmen.

Dein Profil

  • Dein Studium: Du studierst in einem höheren Bachelorsemester oder ersten Mastersemester (Geo-/Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder hast einen Schwerpunkt in Data Science/Statistik. Du hast auch einen gültigen Immatrikulationsnachweis.

  • Du behältst auch unter Druck einen kühlen Kopf und fühlst dich in einem operativen Umfeld wohl, in dem kurzfristig auf Probleme reagiert werden muss.

Bei uns erwartet dich ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem neue Ideen ausdrücklich willkommen sind und Feedback nicht nur erlaubt, sondern erwünscht ist. Wir hinterfragen Bestehendes, arbeiten agil und entwickeln uns kontinuierlich weiter. data.title: Finance Manager (m/w/d) – Accounting & Controlling
data.description:
Jobbeschreibung

Über Teaching Socials

Teaching Socials ist eine der führenden Unternehmensberatungen für Personal Brands im Finanz- und Immobiliensektor im DACH-Raum.

Hinter unserem Wachstum steht ein Team aus 25 High-Performern, das innerhalb von nur zwei Jahren ein stabiles Monatsvolumen von über 750.000 € aufgebaut hat. Doch Wachstum allein reicht uns nicht. Wir wollen Strukturen schaffen, die mit uns skalieren.

Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Sichtbarkeit, Kundenakquise und Unternehmenswachstum greifen bei uns in einem System ineinander. Damit dieses System auch finanziell sauber funktioniert, brauchen wir jemanden, der nicht einfach nur Zahlen verwaltet, sondern Verantwortung für unsere Finance-Strukturen übernimmt und sie aktiv mit uns weiterentwickelt.

Deine Rolle bei uns

Wir suchen keinen Buchhalter, der morgens Aufgaben bekommt und sie abends abhakt.

Wir suchen jemanden, der den Anspruch hat, dass Zahlen stimmen, Prozesse funktionieren und die Geschäftsführung jederzeit weiß, wo das Unternehmen finanziell steht.

Du hältst unsere Buchhaltung zuverlässig am Laufen, schaffst Transparenz in unseren Finanzzahlen und arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung sowie unseren externen Steuerberatern zusammen. Dabei übernimmst du nicht einfach bestehende Strukturen.

Du hilfst uns, sie besser zu machen.

Vom ersten Tag an bekommst du Verantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, Finance-Prozesse aufzubauen, die zu einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen passen.

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Verantwortung ab Tag 1: Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unsere finanziellen Abläufe und Entscheidungen.
  • Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung: Keine langen Abstimmungsschleifen, sondern schnelle Entscheidungen und klare Kommunikation.
  • Gestalten statt nur verwalten: Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, Finance-Strukturen und Prozesse aktiv mit aufzubauen und zu optimieren.
  • Ein Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs: Du arbeitest in einem Umfeld, in dem sich Dinge bewegen und gute Ideen schnell umgesetzt werden.
  • Moderne Arbeitsweise: Digitale Tools, Automatisierungen und AI-Lösungen gehören für uns zu einem modernen Finance-Bereich dazu.
  • Ein ambitioniertes Team: 25 Menschen mit hohen Ansprüchen an ihre Arbeit und einem gemeinsamen Ziel.

Deine Aufgaben

Buchhaltung & Rechnungswesen

Du sorgst dafür, dass unser finanzielles Fundament sauber steht.

Dazu gehören:

  • Erstellung und Prüfung von Ausgangs- und Eingangsrechnungen
  • Forderungsmanagement und Mahnwesen
  • laufende Pflege und Vorbereitung der Buchhaltung
  • Abstimmung mit Steuerberatern und externen Partnern
  • Sicherstellung sauberer und fristgerechter Abläufe

Finanzübersicht & Controlling

Du machst aus Zahlen einen Überblick, mit dem wir arbeiten können.

Du unterstützt uns bei:

  • Forecasts, Budgetübersichten und finanziellen Auswertungen
  • Pflege und Kontrolle relevanter Finanzkennzahlen
  • Reports und Entscheidungsgrundlagen für die Geschäftsführung
  • Monatsabschlüssen und Finanzanalysen

Prozesse, Automatisierung & Systeme

Wenn ein Prozess unnötig kompliziert ist, wollen wir ihn nicht einfach akzeptieren.

Gemeinsam mit uns:

  • optimierst und automatisierst du bestehende Finance-Prozesse
  • wirkst du bei der Einführung digitaler Tools und AI-Lösungen mit
  • strukturierst und dokumentierst du interne Abläufe
  • entwickelst du unsere Finance-Strukturen mit dem Wachstum des Unternehmens weiter

Kommunikation & Organisation

Du bist:

  • zentrale Ansprechperson für interne und externe Finance-Themen
  • verantwortlich für die verständliche Aufbereitung relevanter Zahlen und Informationen
  • Schnittstelle zwischen Geschäftsführung, Steuerberatung und weiteren Partnern
  • Unterstützung bei administrativen Finance-Themen

Uns ist nicht wichtig, dass dein Lebenslauf jedes einzelne Kästchen perfekt abhakt.

Warum diese Position spannend ist

Vielleicht könntest du auch in einem Unternehmen arbeiten, in dem seit zehn Jahren dieselben Finance-Prozesse existieren.

Bei uns bekommst du etwas anderes.

Du kommst in einer Phase zu Teaching Socials, in der bereits ein starkes Geschäft und ein ambitioniertes Team vorhanden sind – gleichzeitig gibt es noch viel Raum, Strukturen mitzugestalten.

Du verwaltest hier nicht nur Buchhaltung. Du baust mit uns den Finance-Bereich, den unser weiteres Wachstum braucht.

Wenn du Lust darauf hast, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Ordnung in Zahlen und Prozesse zu bringen und gemeinsam mit uns ein schnell wachsendes Unternehmen weiterzuentwickeln, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Bewirb dich bei uns und zeig uns, warum du die Person bist, der wir unsere Zahlen anvertrauen sollten.

data.title: Sales Engineer (w/m/x) DACH
data.description:
Nuventura ist ein in Berlin ansässiges Climate-Tech-Unternehmen, das eine neue Generation von Mittelspannungsschaltanlagen entwickelt – hochinnovativ und gleichzeitig nachhaltig. Mit unserer patentierten gasisolierten Technologie ersetzen wir SF₆ – eines der klimaschädlichsten Treibhausgase – durch saubere, trockene Luft und erreichen dabei die gleiche Zuverlässigkeit und Leistungsfähigkeit wie konventionelle Systeme.

Unsere Mission ist es, den globalen Übergang zu einer nachhaltigen elektrischen Infrastruktur zu beschleunigen. Dafür arbeiten wir an der Schnittstelle von tiefgehender Engineering-Expertise, industriellen Partnerschaften und schneller Produktentwicklung. Unser Produktportfolio wächst dynamisch durch neue Entwicklungsprojekte und internationale Skalierungsaktivitäten. Als interdisziplinäres und engineering-getriebenes Unternehmen ermöglichen wir Energieversorgern und Herstellern weltweit, SF₆-freie Technologie zu etablieren und Stromnetze zukunftssicher zu machen.

Deine Rolle

Als Sales Engineer (w/m/x) DACH treibst du den technischen und kaufmännischen Vertrieb unserer SF₆-freien Mittelspannungsschaltanlagen in der DACH-Region voran. Du spielst eine zentrale Rolle bei der Entwicklung und Pflege von Kundenbeziehungen zu Verteilnetzbetreibern (DSOs), EPC-Unternehmen und anderen Marktteilnehmern. Du übersetzt Kundenanforderungen in überzeugende technische Angebote und trägst so direkt zum Umsatzwachstum und langfristigen Kundenbeziehungen bei.

Aufgaben

  • Analyse und Erstellung technischer Angebote und Kalkulationen auf Basis von Kundenspezifikationen.

  • Ansprechpartner:in für DSOs, EPCs und Partner bei technischen Anfragen.
  • Erstellung und Einreichung von Angeboten für Ausschreibungen, RFIs und RFQs.
  • Teilnahme an technischen und kaufmännischen Meetings mit Kunden, DSOs und Partnern.
  • Entwicklung und Pflege zugewiesener Kundenkonten in der DACH-Region.
  • Abstimmung mit den Engineering-Teams bei nicht-standardisierten Anforderungen.
  • Beobachtung der Wettbewerberpositionierung und Markttrends.
  • Unterstützung von Messen und gelegentliche Vertriebsaktivitäten in der BENELUX-Region.
  • Mitwirkung bei der Erstellung von Vertriebspräsentationen für den DACH-Markt.

Qualifikation

  • Abschluss im Bereich Elektrotechnik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Fundiertes Verständnis für Mittelspannungsschaltanlagen und Stromverteilung.
  • Fließend Deutsch (verpflichtend), gute Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil.
  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im industriellen Vertrieb, Business Development oder verwandten Bereichen.
  • Technische Expertise in der Angebotserstellung, Lesen von Einlinienschaltplänen und Spezifikationen.
  • Kenntnisse in CRM-Tools und beratungsintensivem Vertrieb mit Fokus auf ROI und Geschäftsergebnisse.
  • Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, kundenorientiertes Denken und Belastbarkeit.
  • Strukturierte, analytische Arbeitsweise und gutes Urteilsvermögen.
  • Standort Berlin, Bereitschaft zu Reisetätigkeit in der DACH-Region.

Benefits

  • Du wirst Teil eines innovativen Teams aus leistungsstarken und erfahrenen Persönlichkeiten mit vielfältigen Hintergründen.
  • Wir fördern dein Wachstum und fordern dich gezielt heraus, um die beste professionelle Version deiner selbst zu werden.
  • Wir leben eine Kultur von verantwortungsvollem Ownership, Caring Meritocracy und konstruktivem Feedback, in der wir uns gegenseitig fordern und weiterentwickeln.
  • Ein nachhaltiges, bodenständiges und leidenschaftliches Unternehmen.
  • Kostenlose Snacks, Getränke und täglich frisches Obst.
  • Regelmäßige und spannende Teamevents, inklusive Weihnachtsfeier, Sommerfest und Budget für Team-Events.

Bereit, die Zukunft der nachhaltigen elektrischen Infrastruktur mitzugestalten?

Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil unserer Mission, Stromnetze SF₆-frei zu machen.

Nuventura ist eine Arbeitgeberin, die Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir schätzen Vielfalt und setzen uns dafür ein, ein inklusives Umfeld für alle Mitarbeitenden zu schaffen.

data.title: Sales Engineer (f/m/x) DACH
data.description:
Nuventura is a Berlin-based climate tech company developing a new generation of medium-voltage switchgear that is both highly innovative and environmentally sustainable. With our patented gas-insulated technology, we replace SF₆ — one of the most harmful greenhouse gases — with clean, dry air, while maintaining the same reliability and performance as conventional systems.

Our mission is to accelerate the global transition toward sustainable electrical infrastructure. To achieve this, we work at the intersection of deep engineering expertise, industrial partnerships, and rapid product development. Our product portfolio is expanding quickly through new development projects and international scaling activities. As an interdisciplinary and engineering-driven company, we enable utilities and manufacturers worldwide to adopt SF₆-free technology and make power grids future-proof.

Your Role

As a Sales Engineer (f/m/x) DACH, you will drive the technical and commercial sales of Nuventura’s SF₆-free medium-voltage switchgear across the DACH region. You will play a key role in developing and growing accounts with DSOs, EPCs, and other market players, turning customer requirements into compelling technical offers. Your work will directly contribute to revenue growth and long-term account relationships.

Tasks

  • Analyze and prepare technical offers and quotations tailored to customer specifications.
  • Support customer meetings, technical clarifications, and account development activities.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for DSOs, EPCs, and partners on technical inquiries.
  • Prepare and submit responses to tenders, RFIs, and RFQs.
  • Join technical and commercial meetings with customers, DSOs, and partners.
  • Develop and grow assigned accounts in the DACH region.
  • Coordinate with engineering teams on non-standard requirements.
  • Track competitor positioning and market trends.
  • Support trade fairs and occasional sales activities in the BENELUX region.
  • Assist in preparing sales presentations for the DACH market.

Requirements

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent qualification.
  • Strong understanding of medium-voltage switchgear and power distribution.
  • Fluent in German; proficiency in English.
  • Proven experience in industrial sales, business development, or a related field.
  • Technical expertise in offer preparation, reading single-line diagrams, and specifications.
  • Proficiency in CRM tools and consultative selling with a focus on ROI and business outcomes.
  • Strong communication skills, customer-oriented mindset, and ability to work under pressure.
  • Structured, analytical, and with good judgment.
  • Based in Berlin, with willingness to travel within the DACH region.

Benefits

  • You will be part of an innovative group of high-performance and experienced people from diverse backgrounds.
  • We are committed to your growth and will challenge you directly to become the best professional version of yourself.
  • We believe in a culture of trusted ownership, caring meritocracy, and constructive feedback where we elevate each other and challenge the status quo.
  • A sustainable, down-to-earth, and passionate company.
  • Free snacks, drinks and fruit basket every day.
  • Exciting and regular team events, including a Christmas party, summer celebrations with a budget for departmental events.

Ready to shape the future of sustainable electrical infrastructure?

Apply now and join our mission to make power grids SF₆-free.

Nuventura is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

data.title: (Junior) Research Consultant im Bereich Marktforschung (w/m/d)
data.description:
Du willst Projekte eigenständig vorantreiben und unseren Kund:innen mit deinen Analysen einen echten Vorsprung im Markt verschaffen? Als (Junior) Research Consultant bei Civey leitest du quantitative Forschungsprojekte von der Konzeption bis zur Ergebnispräsentation. Du entwickelst tragfähige Studiendesigns und bringst komplexe Zusammenhänge klar auf den Punkt. Mit deiner Expertise unterstützt du unsere Kund:innen aus Politik, Wirtschaft und Medien dabei, auf Basis fundierter Daten belastbare strategische Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Aufgaben

  • Du planst, steuerst und betreust nationale und internationale quantitative Markt- und Meinungsforschungsstudien im Auftrag unserer Kund:innen – vom Studiendesign bis zur Ergebnispräsentation
  • Dabei begleitest du unsere Kunden mit deiner Expertise. Du bist methodische:r Ansprechpartner:in, insbesondere in der Fragebogenentwicklung und der Umsetzung des Studiendesigns
  • Du verantwortest die Umsetzung der Studien in unserem Live-System und sorgst für eine hohe Datenqualität
  • Du leitest klare Erkenntnisse aus den erhobenen Daten ab, bringst Ergebnisse auf den Punkt und präsentierst diese souverän beim Kunden
  • Gemeinsam mit unserem Vertriebsteam entwickelst du individuelle Lösungen, die unsere Kund:innen begeistern
  • Du arbeitest mit Unternehmens- und Agenturkunden aus vielfältigen Branchen zusammen

Qualifikation

  • Du verfügst über erste Berufserfahrung, vorzugsweise in einem Marktfoschungs- oder Beratungsunternehmen
